item.title: [BM] Anwar Panggil Tindakan AS-Israel 'Neo-Imperialis' Dan Kata Iran Tak Boleh Diminta 'Tahan Diri' — Sementara Malaysia Rugi RM2 Bilion Sebulan
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-16

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Di pelancaran Mushaf Malaysia MADANI di Putrajaya pada 16 Mac, Perdana Menteri Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim mendedahkan beliau telah mengadakan pusingan kedua perbincangan dengan pemimpin Iran, Oman, Arab Saudi, Qatar, Kuwait, UAE dan Türkiye mengenai konflik Asia Barat. Beliau menyifatkan serangan AS-Israel ke atas Iran sebagai “pameran keangkuhan yang keterlaluan” dan “reka bentuk neo-imperialis,” dan berkata: “Sukar untuk meminta mereka hanya menahan diri.” Beliau mengesahkan konflik itu menelan kos “subsidi tambahan RM2 bilion sebulan” untuk kekalkan harga RON95. Beliau juga memberi amaran terhadap “elemen tidak bertanggungjawab yang mengeksploitasi kes ini dan menggunakannya sebagai senjata politik.”

item.title: [BM] Hannah Yeoh Kata Bajet Jalan KL RM33 Juta 'Tak Cukup' — Tiga Tahun Jadi Menteri, Baru Sekarang Perasan
item.description:
Said by: Hannah Yeoh, Minister in the Prime Minister’s Department (Federal Territories)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-16

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Hannah Yeoh, Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Wilayah Persekutuan), beritahu pemberita pada 16 Mac bahawa peruntukan langsung persekutuan RM33 juta untuk penyelenggaraan jalan di KL “tidak mencukupi” memandangkan lebih sejuta kenderaan masuk ke bandar setiap hari. Beliau kata isu ini telah dibangkitkan kepada Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim dalam mesyuarat Majlis Kewangan Negara. Kenyataan dibuat semasa lawatan tapak kerja penyelenggaraan jalan di projek perumahan awam Pudu.

item.title: [BM] Kerajaan Madani Guna Seksyen 124B Terhadap 14 Aktivis Dan Ahli Akademik — Gabungan Yang Janji Reformasi Kini Ayun Senjata Kegemaran BN
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister (Government Spokesperson)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-16

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Polis Diraja Malaysia telah memanggil 14 aktivis, ahli akademik, dan penyelidik politik untuk disoal siasat di bawah Seksyen 124B Kanun Keseksaan — peruntukan yang membawa hukuman penjara sehingga 20 tahun — sebagai sebahagian daripada siasatan dakwaan komplot “menggulingkan kerajaan dan mensabotaj kestabilan negara.” Antara yang disoal ialah CEO C4 Centre Pushpan Murugiah, disoal siasat selama 90 minit pada 10 Mac. Pada 16 Mac, gabungan pertubuhan masyarakat sivil mengeluarkan kenyataan bersama mengecam kerajaan Madani, bertanya: “Adakah kita mahu kembali ke zaman kerajaan tidak boleh dikritik?” Menteri Komunikasi Fahmi Fadzil, jurucakap kerajaan, menetapkan nada pada 27 Februari apabila beliau menyifatkan dakwaan komplot itu sebagai “perkara yang sangat serius” dan berkata kerajaan akan “serahkan kepada polis.” Kerajaan tidak membuat sebarang kenyataan awam untuk mengecilkan skop siasatan atau menangani kebimbangan tentang kebebasan sivil sejak siasatan diperluaskan kepada tokoh masyarakat sivil.

item.title: Anwar Calls US-Israel Actions 'Neo-Imperialistic' and Says Iran Can't Be Asked to 'Simply Contain Themselves' — While Malaysia Bleeds RM2 Billion a Month
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-16

📌 What Happened

At the launch of the Mushaf Malaysia MADANI in Putrajaya on March 16, Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim disclosed that he had held a second round of discussions with leaders from Iran, Oman, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, the UAE, and Türkiye about the West Asia conflict. He described the US-Israeli strikes on Iran as a “sheer display of arrogance” and “neo-imperialistic design,” and said: “It is difficult to ask them simply to contain themselves.” He confirmed the conflict is costing Malaysia an “additional subsidy of RM2 billion a month” to maintain RON95 prices. He also warned against “irresponsible elements exploiting the case and using it as a political weapon, weaponising it to attack.”

item.title: Hannah Yeoh Says KL's RM33m Road Budget 'Not Enough' — After Three Years as Minister, She Just Noticed
item.description:
Said by: Hannah Yeoh, Minister in the Prime Minister’s Department (Federal Territories)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-16

📌 What Happened

Hannah Yeoh, Minister in the Prime Minister’s Department (Federal Territories), told reporters on March 16 that KL’s RM33 million direct federal allocation for road maintenance is “not enough” given that over one million vehicles enter the city daily. She said she had raised the matter with Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim during a National Finance Council meeting. The remarks were made during a site visit to inspect road resurfacing works at a public housing project in Pudu.

item.title: Madani Government Uses Section 124B Against 14 Activists and Academics — The Coalition That Promised Reform Now Wields BN's Favourite Weapon
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister (Government Spokesperson)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-16

📌 What Happened

The Royal Malaysia Police have summoned 14 activists, academics, and political researchers for questioning under Section 124B of the Penal Code — a provision carrying up to 20 years in prison — as part of an investigation into an alleged plot to “topple the government and sabotage national stability.” Among those questioned was C4 Centre CEO Pushpan Murugiah, grilled for 90 minutes on March 10. On March 16, a coalition of civil society groups issued a joint statement condemning the Madani government, asking: “Do we want to return to a time when the government cannot be criticised?” Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil, the government’s spokesperson, set the tone on February 27 when he called the alleged plot “a very serious matter” and said the government would “leave it to the police.” The government has made no public statement to narrow the scope of the investigation or address concerns about civil liberties since the probe widened to include civil society figures.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Kata 40% Hasil Sabah 'Kes Ditutup' — Sambil Pada Masa Sama Failkan Permohonan Mahkamah Atas Penghakiman Yang Sama
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Di majlis Madani Iftar di Universiti Malaysia Sabah pada malam 15 Mac, Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim isytiharkan komitmen kerajaan persekutuan terhadap hak hasil 40 peratus Sabah di bawah MA63 sebagai ‘muktamad’ dan ‘kes ditutup.’ Dalam ucapan sama, beliau sahkan kerajaan masih ke mahkamah — bukan untuk rayu 40% itu, tegasnya, tetapi untuk ‘minta penjelasan’ atas bahagian penghakiman Mahkamah Tinggi yang katanya ’tidak adil mempersoalkan peranan pemimpin negara dan negeri terdahulu’ termasuk Tunku Abdul Rahman dan Tun Abdul Razak. Permohonan penangguhan pelaksanaan dijadualkan di Mahkamah Rayuan pada 31 Mac. Tarikh akhir pematuhan 180 hari Mahkamah Tinggi tamat 15 April.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Kata 40% Hasil Sabah 'Kes Ditutup' — Sementara Kerajaannya Failkan Ke Mahkamah Dan Pohon Penangguhan Pelaksanaan
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Di Majlis Iftar Madani di Universiti Malaysia Sabah pada 15 Mac, Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim memberitahu hadirin — termasuk Ketua Menteri Sabah Hajiji Noor — bahawa pendirian kerajaan persekutuan mengenai hak hasil 40 peratus Sabah di bawah MA63 adalah ‘muktamad’ dan ‘kes ditutup.’ Dalam nafas yang sama, beliau sahkan Putrajaya akan ke mahkamah — bukan untuk merayu 40 peratus, katanya, tetapi untuk ‘mendapatkan penjelasan’ terhadap bahagian penghakiman Mahkamah Tinggi yang didakwa mempersoalkan legasi Tunku Abdul Rahman, Tun Abdul Razak, Tun Mustapha, Tun Fuad Stephens, dan lain-lain. Permohonan penangguhan pelaksanaan dijadualkan didengar di Mahkamah Rayuan pada 31 Mac, dan kerajaan Sabah sudah nyatakan akan menentangnya.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Kata 40% Hasil Sabah 'Kes Ditutup' — Sementara Kerajaannya Failkan Tindakan Mahkamah Untuk Buka Semula

item.title: [BM] Anwar Kata Hak Hasil 40% Sabah 'Sudah Selesai' — Sementara Kerajaannya Ke Mahkamah Cabar Penghakiman
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 15 Mac 2026, Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim memberitahu majlis Iftar Madani di Universiti Malaysia Sabah, Kota Kinabalu, bahawa komitmen kerajaan persekutuan terhadap hak hasil 40 peratus Sabah di bawah Perjanjian Malaysia 1963 adalah ‘muktamad’ dan ’tidak tertakluk kepada rayuan.’ Beliau tegas: ‘Tiada rundingan. Kami komited untuk menunaikan komitmen 40 peratus kepada rakyat Sabah. Titik.’ Di acara berasingan, beliau ulangi — ‘kes selesai.’ Tapi dalam masa yang sama, beliau sahkan kerajaan akan ke mahkamah — bukan untuk cabar 40 peratus, katanya, tetapi untuk ‘dapatkan penjelasan’ mengenai bahagian penghakiman Mahkamah Tinggi Oktober 2025 yang didakwa mempersoalkan legasi pemimpin lampau. Perbicaraan penangguhan pelaksanaan dijadualkan 31 Mac. Kerajaan Sabah kata mereka akan tentang penangguhan itu.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Kata Hasil 40% Sabah 'Kes Ditutup, Noktah' — Sambil Failkan Permohonan Mahkamah Untuk Buka Semula Sebahagian Penghakiman
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Di majlis Iftar Madani di Universiti Malaysia Sabah pada 15 Mac, Perdana Menteri Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim mengisytiharkan bahawa hak hasil 40 peratus Sabah di bawah Perjanjian Malaysia 1963 adalah “muktamad, kes ditutup” dan tidak akan ada “rayuan, rundingan, noktah.” Dalam ucapan yang sama, beliau menjelaskan kerajaan persekutuan akan ke mahkamah — bukan untuk merayu 40 peratus, tegasnya, tetapi untuk “mendapatkan penjelasan” mengenai bahagian penghakiman Mahkamah Tinggi yang dikatakan mempersoalkan peranan pemimpin terdahulu termasuk Tunku Abdul Rahman, Tun Abdul Razak, dan tokoh Sabah seperti Tun Fuad Stephens dan Tan Sri Harris Salleh. Permohonan penangguhan pelaksanaan dijadualkan untuk pendengaran di Mahkamah Rayuan pada 31 Mac. Kerajaan Sabah menyatakan akan membantah penangguhan tersebut.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Kata Malaysia 'Tak Boleh Campur Tangan' Ketenteraan Di Timur Tengah — Tak Ada Siapa Tanya Pun, Tapi Terima Kasih Jelaskan
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Di acara Hari Pengguna Kebangsaan 2026 di Kota Kinabalu pada 15 Mac, Perdana Menteri Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim mengisytiharkan bahawa Malaysia “tidak boleh terlibat dengan apa yang berlaku di Timur Tengah, terutamanya melalui campur tangan ketenteraan.” Beliau berkata Malaysia, sebagai negara merdeka, boleh menyuarakan bantahan terhadap peperangan dan keganasan, dan menyatakan: “Kita bantah serangan Israel dan Amerika Syarikat terhadap Iran.” Beliau mengakui bahawa penutupan Selat Hormuz membawa implikasi yang “serius” dan “berkemungkinan bertambah buruk” serta kos sara hidup “pasti akan meningkat.”

item.title: [BM] Anwar Umum Cuti Raya Tambahan Di Tengah Krisis Minyak — Kerana Tiada Yang Lebih 'Jimat Cermat' Dari Cuti Sehari Lagi
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim mengumumkan cuti umum tambahan untuk Hari Raya Aidilfitri pada 15 Mac 2026, berucap di sambutan Hari Pengguna Kebangsaan di Suria Sabah, Kota Kinabalu. Cuti tambahan itu akan jatuh sama ada pada Jumaat 20 Mac atau Isnin 23 Mac, bergantung pada pencerapan anak bulan Syawal. Anwar membingkainya sebagai ganjaran untuk “usaha dan dedikasi” rakyat sepanjang Ramadan, berkata pengumuman awal akan membantu rakyat Malaysia merancang perjalanan. Pengumuman dibuat bersama Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri Armizan Mohd Ali, yang pada masa sama melancarkan skim kawalan harga perayaan 15 hari meliputi 22–24 barangan keperluan.

Hari cuti tambahan itu akan jatuh sama ada pada Jumaat 20 Mac atau Isnin 23 Mac, bergantung kepada pengisytiharan anak bulan Syawal. item.title: [BM] Anwar Umum Cuti Raya Tambahan Ketika Krisis Minyak — Kerana Tiada Yang Lebih 'Jimat Cermat' Dari Cuti Tambahan
item.description:

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-15

Cuti tambahan akan jatuh sama ada pada Jumaat 20 Mac atau Isnin 23 Mac, bergantung pada penentuan anak bulan Syawal. Anwar membingkaikan pengumuman ini sebagai ganjaran atas “usaha dan dedikasi” rakyat sepanjang Ramadan, sambil berkata pengumuman awal ini membolehkan rakyat merancang perjalanan. Pengumuman dibuat bersama Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri Armizan Mohd Ali, yang turut melancarkan Skim Harga Maksimum Musim Perayaan selama 15 hari meliputi 22–24 barangan keperluan.

item.title: [BM] Puah Akui Pengundi Teras PH 'Bergoyang' — Tiga Tahun Berkuasa, Masih Perlu 'Yakinkan' Rakyat Mereka Reformis
item.description:
Said by: Jimmy Puah Wee Tse, PKR MP for Tebrau

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 15 Mac 2026, Ahli Parlimen PKR Jimmy Puah Wee Tse — AP Tebrau dan Naib Ketua PKR Johor — memberitahu FMT bahawa pengundi teras Pakatan Harapan, terutamanya golongan M40 dan pengundi bandar, sedang “bergoyang.” Puah berkata gabungan itu mesti yakinkan pengundi ini bahawa ia telah “benar-benar melaksanakan” reformasi, atau sekurang-kurangnya “sedang dalam proses,” sebelum boleh berunding tentang rakan gabungan untuk PRU16. Saintis politik Wong Chin Huat dari Universiti Sunway turut memberi amaran, kata penyokong teras PH memerhati rapat bagaimana Anwar mengurus keseimbangan kaum dan agama Malaysia, dan “berbolak-balik antara memuaskan hati nasionalis Melayu dan merayu golongan minoriti dan liberal” boleh mengasingkan mereka lagi.

item.title: [BM] Puah Akui Pengundi Teras PH 'Bergoyang' — Tiga Tahun Berlalu, Masih Perlu 'Yakinkan' Rakyat Mereka Reformis
item.description:
Said by: Jimmy Puah Wee Tse, PKR MP for Tebrau

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 15 Mac 2026, Ahli Parlimen PKR Jimmy Puah Wee Tse — AP Tebrau dan Naib Ketua PKR Johor — memberitahu FMT bahawa pangkalan pengundi teras Pakatan Harapan, khususnya golongan M40 dan pengundi bandar, sedang “bergoyang.” Puah berkata gabungan itu mesti meyakinkan pengundi-pengundi ini bahawa ia telah “benar-benar menunaikan” reformasi, atau sekurang-kurangnya “sedang dalam proses menunaikan,” sebelum boleh berunding mengenai rakan gabungan untuk PRU16. Saintis politik Wong Chin Huat dari Universiti Sunway turut memberi amaran, menyatakan bahawa penyokong teras PH sedang memerhatikan bagaimana Anwar menguruskan keseimbangan kaum dan agama Malaysia, dan bahawa “berbolak-balik antara memuaskan hati nasionalis Melayu dan memikat minoriti serta liberal” boleh mengasingkan mereka lagi.

item.title: [BM] Zafrul Berkhutbah 'Politik Berani' Dalam Op-Ed — Dari Lelaki Yang Kerajaannya Lindungi Ketua SPRM Dan Gagal Reformasi Sendiri
item.description:
Said by: Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz, Senior Political Advisor to the Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz, Penasihat Politik Kanan Perdana Menteri, menulis ruangan pendapat dalam edisi The Edge Malaysia 16–22 Mac bertajuk Can Malaysian politics unite the country when the world is coming apart? Beliau menyeru ‘politik berani’ — ‘keberanian bercakap jujur dengan rakyat,’ ‘keberanian membuat keputusan sukar tetapi tidak popular,’ dan ‘keberanian menolak politik pecah-belah demi kepentingan jangka pendek.’ Beliau memberi amaran bahawa ‘Malaysia tidak mampu lagi bergelumang dengan politik partisan yang mementingkan diri sendiri’ dan berhujah bahawa kesepaduan sosial adalah ‘asas kepada kekuatan ekonomi.’

item.title: Anwar Announces Extra Raya Holiday Amid Oil Crisis — Because Nothing Says 'Austerity' Like Another Day Off
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 What Happened

Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim announced an additional public holiday for Hari Raya Aidilfitri on March 15, 2026, speaking at the National Consumer Day celebration at Suria Sabah in Kota Kinabalu. The extra day off will fall on either Friday March 20 or Monday March 23, depending on the moon sighting for Syawal. Anwar framed it as a reward for the people’s “efforts and dedication” during Ramadan, saying the early announcement would help Malaysians plan their travel. The announcement was made alongside Domestic Trade Minister Armizan Mohd Ali, who simultaneously launched a 15-day festive price control scheme covering 22–24 essential goods.

item.title: Anwar Says Malaysia 'Cannot Get Involved' Militarily in Middle East — Nobody Asked, But Thanks for Clarifying
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 What Happened

At the National Consumer Day 2026 event in Kota Kinabalu on March 15, Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim declared that Malaysia “cannot get involved in what is happening in the Middle East, especially through military intervention.” He said Malaysia, as a “free country,” can voice its objections to war and violence, and stated: “We object to the attacks by Israel and the United States on Iran.” He acknowledged that the closure of the Strait of Hormuz would have “serious” implications that are “likely to worsen” and that “the cost of living would definitely rise.”

item.title: Anwar Says Sabah 40% Revenue 'Case Closed, Period' — While Filing a Court Application to Reopen Parts of the Judgment
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 What Happened

At a Madani Iftar event at Universiti Malaysia Sabah on March 15, Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim declared that Sabah’s 40 per cent revenue entitlement under the Malaysia Agreement 1963 is “final, case closed” and that there will be “no appeal, no negotiations, period.” In the same speech, he explained that the federal government is going to court — not to appeal the 40 per cent, he insists, but to “seek clarification” on parts of the High Court judgment that he says unfairly questioned the roles of past leaders including Tunku Abdul Rahman, Tun Abdul Razak, and Sabah stalwarts like Tun Fuad Stephens and Tan Sri Harris Salleh. A stay of execution application is scheduled for hearing at the Court of Appeal on March 31. The Sabah government has indicated it will oppose the stay.

item.title: Anwar Says Sabah 40% Revenue 'Case Closed' — While Simultaneously Filing a Court Application Over the Same Judgment
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 What Happened

At a Madani Iftar event at Universiti Malaysia Sabah on the night of March 15, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim declared the federal government’s commitment to Sabah’s 40 per cent revenue entitlement under MA63 is ‘final’ and ‘case closed.’ In the same speech, he confirmed the government is still going to court — not to appeal the 40%, he insists, but to ‘seek clarification’ on parts of the High Court judgment that he says ‘unfairly questioned the roles of past national and state leaders’ including Tunku Abdul Rahman and Tun Abdul Razak. A stay of execution application is scheduled for the Court of Appeal on March 31. The High Court’s 180-day compliance deadline expires April 15.

item.title: Anwar Says Sabah 40% Revenue Is 'Case Closed' — While His Government Files Court Action to Reopen It
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 What Happened

At a Madani Iftar event at Universiti Malaysia Sabah on March 15, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim told the audience — including Sabah Chief Minister Hajiji Noor — that the federal government’s position on Sabah’s 40 per cent revenue entitlement is ‘final’ and ‘case closed.’ In the same breath, he confirmed that Putrajaya is proceeding to the Court of Appeal — not to challenge the 40 per cent, he insists, but to seek ‘clarification’ on parts of the High Court judgment that he claims unfairly questioned the legacies of Tunku Abdul Rahman, Tun Abdul Razak, and Sabah leaders like Tun Mustapha and Tun Fuad Stephens. A stay of execution application is scheduled for March 31. The Sabah government has indicated it will oppose.

item.title: Anwar Says Sabah 40% Revenue Is 'Case Closed' — While His Government Files to Court and Seeks a Stay of Execution
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 What Happened

At a Madani Iftar event at Universiti Malaysia Sabah on March 15, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim told the audience — including Sabah Chief Minister Hajiji Noor — that the federal government’s position on Sabah’s 40 per cent revenue entitlement under MA63 is ‘final’ and ‘case closed.’ In the same breath, he confirmed Putrajaya is going to court — not to appeal the 40 per cent, he insists, but to ‘seek clarification’ on parts of the High Court judgment that he claims unfairly questioned the legacies of Tunku Abdul Rahman, Tun Abdul Razak, Tun Mustapha, Tun Fuad Stephens, and others. A stay of execution application is scheduled to be heard at the Court of Appeal on March 31, and the Sabah government has indicated it will oppose it.

item.title: Anwar Says Sabah 40% Revenue Is 'Case Closed' — While His Government Heads to Court to Challenge the Judgment
item.description:

On March 15, 2026, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim told a Madani Iftar event at Universiti Malaysia Sabah in Kota Kinabalu that the federal government’s commitment to Sabah’s 40 per cent revenue entitlement under the Malaysia Agreement 1963 is ‘final’ and ’not subject to appeal.’ He declared: ‘No negotiations. We are committed to honour our commitment of 40 per cent to the people of Sabah. Period.’ He repeated the line at a separate event, calling it ‘case closed.’ Yet in the same breath, he confirmed the government is going to court — not to challenge the 40 per cent, he insists, but to ‘seek clarification’ on parts of the October 2025 High Court judgment that he says unfairly questioned the legacies of past national and state leaders. A stay of execution hearing is set for March 31. The Sabah government has said it will oppose the stay.

item.title: Puah Admits PH Core Voters Are 'Swinging' — Three Years In, And They Still Need to 'Convince' People They're Reformists
item.description:
Said by: Jimmy Puah Wee Tse, PKR MP for Tebrau

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 What Happened

On March 15, 2026, PKR MP Jimmy Puah Wee Tse — the Tebrau MP and Johor PKR vice-chief — told FMT that Pakatan Harapan’s core voter base, particularly the M40 group and urban electorate, has been “swinging.” Puah said the coalition must convince these voters that it has “actually delivered” on reforms, or at least is “in the midst of delivering,” before it can negotiate coalition partnerships for GE16. Political scientist Wong Chin Huat of Sunway University echoed the warning, noting that PH’s core supporters are closely watching how Anwar has managed Malaysia’s racial and religious balance, and that “flip-flopping between appeasing Muslim nationalists and wooing minorities and liberals” could alienate them further.

item.title: Zafrul Preaches 'Courageous Politics' in Op-Ed — From the Man Whose Government Shields MACC Chief and Failed Its Own Reforms
item.description:
Said by: Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz, Senior Political Advisor to the Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 What Happened

Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz, Senior Political Advisor to the Prime Minister, published an opinion column in The Edge Malaysia’s March 16–22 edition titled Can Malaysian politics unite the country when the world is coming apart? In it, he called for ‘courageous politics’ — ’the courage to speak honestly to the rakyat,’ ’the courage to make tough but unpopular decisions,’ and ’the courage to reject divisive politics for short-term gain.’ He warned that ‘Malaysia cannot afford the luxury of self-indulgent partisanship’ and argued that social cohesion is ‘fundamental to economic strength.’

item.title: DAP's Sangeet Kaur Calls Topple-Government Probe 'Vague' and 'Intimidating' — While Her Own Coalition Built the Narrative
item.description:
Said by: Sangeet Kaur Deo, DAP Women’s Wing Legal Bureau Chief

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-14

📌 What Happened

On March 14, 2026, DAP women’s wing legal bureau chief Sangeet Kaur Deo issued a statement criticising the police investigation into the alleged plot to overthrow the government. She called the probe based on ‘vague allegations’ and warned that ‘sweeping calls for interrogation inevitably create an atmosphere of intimidation and raise concerns about the potential misuse of investigative powers.’ She stressed that ‘state machinery must never be used to silence critics’ and said that if genuine crimes exist, authorities should identify them clearly and state the specific conduct said to constitute those offences. This comes after commentators and civil society figures were summoned for questioning in connection with the probe.

Loke berkata respons kerajaan terhadap skandal itu ’tidak mencukupi’ dan jangkaan orang ramai tidak dipenuhi. Beliau menekankan siasatan telah ‘diperluaskan’ tetapi jauh daripada siasatan bebas sepenuhnya yang dituntut DAP sejak akhir Februari, apabila Bloomberg pertama kali melaporkan pegawai SPRM didakwa membantu rangkaian ahli perniagaan merampas kawalan syarikat melalui serbuan dan siasatan.

item.title: [BM] Loke Akui DAP Gagal Dapatkan RCI Untuk SPRM — Janji 'Buat Susulan' Sementara Kabinet Sendiri Yang Tolak
item.description:
Said by: Anthony Loke Siew Fook, DAP Secretary-General and Transport Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-13

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 13 Mac, Setiausaha Agung DAP dan Menteri Pengangkutan Anthony Loke tampil dalam program dalam talian The Keywords dan mengaku apa yang semua orang sudah tahu: DAP gagal meyakinkan Kabinet untuk menubuhkan Suruhanjaya Siasatan Diraja (RCI) bagi menyiasat Suruhanjaya Pencegahan Rasuah Malaysia (SPRM) dan dakwaan ‘mafia korporat’ yang menyelubungi ketua pesuruhjaya Azam Baki. Jawapan Loke? Siasatan ‘sedang berjalan’ melalui pasukan petugas pelbagai agensi, dan DAP akan ’terus membuat susulan.’ Ini selepas berminggu-minggu DAP lantang menuntut RCI — dari kenyataan Gobind Singh Deo pada 25 Februari, resolusi CEC pada 4 Mac, hingga desakan Teresa Kok pada 12 Mac bahawa RCI lebih baik daripada pasukan petugas.

item.title: [BM] Loke Suruh Steven Sim Berhenti 'Sebut Nama' Soal KM Pulau Pinang — Sementara CEC DAP Tentukan Pengganti Di Sebalik Tabir
item.description:
Said by: Anthony Loke, Transport Minister and DAP Secretary-General

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-13

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Setiausaha Agung DAP dan Menteri Pengangkutan Anthony Loke secara terbuka menegur Pengerusi DAP Pulau Pinang Steven Sim kerana membuat spekulasi tentang siapa yang akan menggantikan Chow Kon Yeow sebagai Ketua Menteri Pulau Pinang. Bercakap dalam podcast Critical Landing Oriental Daily pada 13 Mac, Loke berkata Sim telah “sebut-sebut nama” — menyebut Timbalan Menteri Wanita Lim Hui Ying dan Timbalan Pengerusi Lembaga Tourism Malaysia Yeoh Soon Hin sebagai calon berpotensi. Loke tegas bahawa keputusan ini hak Jawatankuasa Kerja Pusat (CEC), bukan individu, dan suruh Sim “berhenti sebut nama” dan fokus kerja.

item.title: [BM] Rafizi Dakwa Azam Baki Pegang Saham RM14 Juta — Desak Kerajaan Dedahkan Penemuan Pasukan Petugas Yang Disimpan Rapi
item.description:
Said by: Rafizi Ramli, Pandan MP and Former Economy Minister (PKR)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-13

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 13 Mac 2026, Ahli Parlimen Pandan Rafizi Ramli — Naib Presiden PKR dan bekas Menteri Ekonomi — mengeluarkan kenyataan awam mendesak kerajaan mendedahkan sepenuhnya penemuan siasatan pasukan petugas khas terhadap pegangan saham ketua SPRM Azam Baki. Rafizi mendakwa, merujuk sumber kerajaan, bahawa siasatan menemui Azam memegang saham bernilai RM14 juta merentasi sembilan syarikat — jauh melebihi apa yang gaji penjawat awam kanan mampu jelaskan. Setakat ini, jawapan kerajaan: serahkan kepada lembaga tatatertib Jabatan Perkhidmatan Awam, dengan Ketua Setiausaha Negara Shamsul Azri Abu Bakar mengendalikan langkah seterusnya. Tiada pendedahan awam tentang kandungan laporan.

item.title: Anwar Admits Reforms 'Not As Quick As We'd Like' — After Three Years of Broken Promises, That's the Best He's Got
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and PKR President

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-13

📌 What Happened

On March 13, 2026, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim addressed Sarawak PKR members at a “mini convention” in Kuching and admitted that PKR is “not perfect” and that reforms are not being implemented “as quickly as we would like.” He told party members to “close ranks” and continue the reform struggle, declaring: “The true test of executing change or reforms is when one is in the seat of power, not after losing power or having been removed.” This was said on the same day his special Cabinet meeting deferred the WFH decision to yet another review, tripled the RON95 subsidy to RM2 billion instead of reforming it, and had the Agriculture Minister telling Malaysians to grow their own vegetables.

item.title: Hannah Yeoh Praises Raya Open House Ban as 'People-Centred' — While Handing Out RM150 to 200 People at a Photo Op
item.description:
Said by: Hannah Yeoh, Minister in the Prime Minister’s Department (Federal Territories)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-13

📌 What Happened

On March 13, Hannah Yeoh, Minister in the Prime Minister’s Department (Federal Territories), praised PM Anwar Ibrahim’s directive banning Aidilfitri open houses for government agencies and GLCs as a reflection of the “Madani Government’s commitment to being people-centred.” She made the remarks at a donation event in Segambut, where she distributed RM150 cash and bags of rice to 200 recipients including orphans, tahfiz students, and asnaf families — a modest handout worth RM30,000 total, funded by Ehsan Group, a private company.

item.title: Loke Admits DAP Failed to Get RCI on MACC — Promises to 'Follow Up' While His Own Cabinet Killed It
item.description:
Said by: Anthony Loke Siew Fook, DAP Secretary-General and Transport Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-13

📌 What Happened

On March 13, DAP secretary-general and Transport Minister Anthony Loke appeared on the online programme The Keywords and admitted what everyone already knew: DAP failed to persuade the cabinet to establish a Royal Commission of Inquiry (RCI) into the Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC) and the explosive ‘corporate mafia’ allegations surrounding chief commissioner Azam Baki. Loke’s spin? Investigations are ‘underway’ through a multi-agency task force, and DAP will ‘continue to follow up.’ This after weeks of DAP loudly demanding an RCI — from Gobind Singh Deo’s February 25 statement, to the CEC resolution on March 4, to Teresa Kok’s March 12 insistence that an RCI is superior to the task force.

item.title: Loke Admits DAP Failed to Get RCI on MACC 'Corporate Mafia' — The Biggest Party in Government Can't Even Hold Its Own Cabinet Accountable
item.description:
Said by: Anthony Loke, Transport Minister and DAP Secretary-General

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-13

📌 What Happened

DAP secretary-general and Transport Minister Anthony Loke admitted in an interview on the online programme The Keywords — published around March 12–13, 2026 — that DAP was unable to persuade the cabinet to establish a Royal Commission of Inquiry (RCI) into the alleged “corporate mafia” within the Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC). Loke said the government’s response to the scandal has been “inadequate” and that the public’s expectations have not been met. He stressed that investigations have been “expanded” but stopped well short of the full independent inquiry DAP had been calling for since late February, when Bloomberg first reported that MACC officers were allegedly helping a network of businessmen seize control of companies through raids and investigations.

item.title: Loke Tells Steven Sim to Stop 'Name-Dropping' on Penang CM — While DAP's CEC Decides the Succession Behind Closed Doors
item.description:
Said by: Anthony Loke, Transport Minister and DAP Secretary-General

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-13

📌 What Happened

DAP secretary-general and Transport Minister Anthony Loke publicly rebuked Penang DAP chairman Steven Sim for speculating on who should succeed Chow Kon Yeow as Penang Chief Minister. Speaking on Oriental Daily’s Critical Landing podcast on March 13, Loke said Sim had been “name-dropping” — citing Deputy Women Minister Lim Hui Ying and Tourism Malaysia Board deputy chairman Yeoh Soon Hin as potential candidates. Loke declared the decision rests with the party’s Central Executive Committee (CEC), not with any individual, and told Sim to “stop mentioning names” and focus on his work.

item.title: Rafizi Claims Azam Baki Holds RM14 Million in Shares — Demands Government Release Task Force Findings It's Been Sitting On
item.description:
Said by: Rafizi Ramli, Pandan MP and Former Economy Minister (PKR)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-13

📌 What Happened

On March 13, 2026, Pandan MP Rafizi Ramli — PKR vice-president and former Economy Minister — issued a public statement demanding the government release the full findings of the special task force investigation into MACC chief Azam Baki’s shareholdings. Rafizi claimed, citing government sources, that the probe found Azam holds RM14 million worth of shares across nine companies — far exceeding what a senior civil servant’s salary could explain. The government’s response so far: refer the matter to the Public Service Department’s disciplinary board, with Chief Secretary Shamsul Azri Abu Bakar handling next steps. No public disclosure of the report’s contents.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Berkhutbah 'Budaya Integriti' Dan Lancar Program CeIO — Sementara Kerajaan Lindungi Ketua SPRM Dan Soal Siasat NGO Antirasuah
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-12

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 12 Mac 2026, Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim mempengerusikan Jawatankuasa Khas Kabinet Mengenai Tadbir Urus Negara (JKKTN) dan mengumumkan pelancaran program Pegawai Integriti Bertauliah (CeIO). Dalam kiriman Facebook dan liputan Bernama seterusnya, Anwar mengisytiharkan bahawa ‘penguatkuasaan undang-undang sahaja tidak mencukupi untuk memerangi rasuah’ dan menyeru ‘budaya integriti dan amalan tadbir urus yang kukuh yang lebih luas.’ Beliau berkata isu seperti ‘kebocoran dana awam dan salah guna kuasa’ menjejaskan tadbir urus, kesihatan awam, alam sekitar, dan integriti negara.

item.title: [BM] TikTok Padamkan Rakaman Kedua MalaysiaNow Mengenai Azam-Gate — Pengerusi SKMM Yang Melesenkan TikTok Juga Mengetuai Lembaga Penasihat SPRM
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister / MCMC (Mohamad Salim Fateh Din, Chairman)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-12

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 12 Mac 2026, sebuah rakaman MalaysiaNow berdurasi enam minit telah dipadamkan daripada TikTok tanpa sebarang penjelasan. Klip tersebut memaparkan sidang akhbar bersama oleh pemimpin Muda iaitu Ainie Haziqah dan Amira Aisya Abdul Aziz bersama Mukhriz Mahathir dan Rafique Rashid daripada Pejuang, mengumumkan kempen menyerlahkan kegagalan Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim bertindak terhadap ketua SPRM, Azam Baki, berikutan dua siasatan Bloomberg yang menggemparkan. Ini merupakan rakaman MalaysiaNow kedua mengenai isu Azam-gate yang dipadamkan — yang pertama, ringkasan berbahasa Melayu mengenai pendedahan Bloomberg tentang ‘mafia korporat,’ telah dipadamkan pada 13 Februari. Kedua-dua rakaman masih boleh ditonton di YouTube dan platform lain. TikTok merupakan salah satu daripada tiga platform sahaja — bersama WeChat dan Telegram — yang bersetuju dengan rejim pelesenan media sosial kontroversi Suruhanjaya Komunikasi dan Multimedia Malaysia (SKMM), yang berkuat kuasa pada 2026.

item.title: Anwar Preaches 'Integrity Culture' and Launches CeIO Programme — While His Government Shields MACC Chief and Interrogates Anti-Corruption NGOs
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-12

📌 What Happened

On March 12, 2026, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim chaired the Special Cabinet Committee on National Governance (JKKTN) and announced the launch of a Certified Integrity Officer (CeIO) programme. In a Facebook post and subsequent Bernama coverage, Anwar declared that “law enforcement alone is insufficient to combat corruption” and called for “a broader culture of integrity and sound governance practices.” He said issues like “leakage of public funds and abuse of power” undermine governance, public health, the environment, and national integrity. The committee agreed to implement CeIO as part of efforts to “strengthen national governance.”

item.title: TikTok Removes Second MalaysiaNow Video on Azam-Gate — MCMC Chairman Who Licenses TikTok Also Sits on MACC's Advisory Board
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister / MCMC (Mohamad Salim Fateh Din, Chairman)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-12

📌 What Happened

On March 12, 2026, a six-minute MalaysiaNow video was removed from TikTok without explanation. The clip featured a joint press conference by Muda leaders Ainie Haziqah and Amira Aisya Abdul Aziz alongside Pejuang’s Mukhriz Mahathir and Rafique Rashid, announcing a campaign highlighting Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s failure to act on MACC chief Azam Baki following two damning Bloomberg investigations. This is the second MalaysiaNow video on Azam-gate to be taken down — the first, a Malay-language summary of Bloomberg’s ‘corporate mafia’ exposé, was removed on February 13. Both videos remain available on YouTube and other platforms. TikTok is one of only three platforms — alongside WeChat and Telegram — that have agreed to the Malaysian Communications and Multimedia Commission’s (MCMC) controversial social media licensing regime, which came into effect in 2026.

item.title: [BM] Ahli Parlimen Belakang PH Desak Pilihan Raya Kilat Berselindung Di Sebalik 'Reformasi' — Gabung PRU16 Dengan Semua PRN, Jimat Duit Kata Mereka
item.description:
Said by: Azli Yusof (Amanah-Shah Alam) / Jimmy Puah (PKR-Tebrau)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 11 Mac, dua ahli parlimen belakang Pakatan Harapan — Ahli Parlimen Shah Alam Azli Yusof (Amanah) dan Ahli Parlimen Tebrau Jimmy Puah (PKR) — menyeru agar semua pilihan raya dewan undangan negeri diadakan serentak dengan Pilihan Raya Umum ke-16. Bercakap kepada FMT, kedua-dua ahli parlimen berhujah bahawa pilihan raya berasingan membawa kepada peratusan keluar mengundi yang lebih rendah, membazir wang awam, dan menghasilkan kerajaan negeri dengan mandat lebih lemah. Azli berkata pilihan raya berasingan ’tidak adil kepada pengundi, terutamanya mereka yang tinggal jauh dari tempat mengundi.’ Putrajaya membelanjakan RM725 juta untuk PRU15 pada 2022 dan RM420 juta lagi untuk enam pilihan raya negeri seterusnya pada 2023.

item.title: [BM] Fahmi Kata Kabinet Arah 'Siasatan Menyeluruh' Atas SPRM Mafia Korporat — Tapi RCI? Jangan Harap
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister and Government Spokesman

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 11 Mac, Menteri Komunikasi dan jurucakap kerajaan Fahmi Fadzil memberitahu wartawan selepas mesyuarat Kabinet bahawa agensi penguatkuasaan — termasuk polis, Suruhanjaya Sekuriti, SPRM, dan LHDN — diarahkan menjalankan siasatan “menyeluruh” terhadap dakwaan pegawai SPRM terlibat dalam manipulasi pengambilalihan korporat. Fahmi sahkan Kabinet telah terima laporan jawatankuasa khas mengenai skandal pegangan saham ketua SPRM Azam Baki tetapi enggan dedahkan dapatan, kata tindakan lanjut akan diambil oleh Ketua Setiausaha Negara Shamsul Azri Abu Bakar. Ditanya sama ada pelanjutan kontrak Azam dibincangkan, Fahmi kata: “Ia tidak dibincangkan.”

item.title: [BM] Fahmi Kata Kabinet Arah Siasatan 'Mafia Korporat' — Tapi Biar SPRM Siasat Diri Sendiri Dan Abaikan Seruan RCI
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 11 Mac, Menteri Komunikasi Datuk Fahmi Fadzil mengumumkan bahawa Kabinet telah mengarahkan agensi penguatkuasaan — termasuk polis (PDRM), Suruhanjaya Sekuriti (SC), Suruhanjaya Pencegahan Rasuah Malaysia (SPRM), dan Lembaga Hasil Dalam Negeri (LHDN) — menjalankan “siasatan terperinci” terhadap dakwaan rangkaian “mafia korporat” beroperasi dalam SPRM. Perintah itu datang berminggu selepas Bloomberg menerbitkan laporan penyiasatan bertajuk Who’s Watching Malaysia’s Anti-Corruption Watchdog? yang mendakwa pegawai SPRM menekan tokoh korporat dalam kes pengambilalihan. Yang ketara tiada dalam pengumuman Fahmi: sebarang sebutan tentang Suruhanjaya Siasatan Diraja (RCI), walaupun seruan semakin kuat daripada ahli parlimen — termasuk Teresa Kok dari PH sendiri.

item.title: [BM] Fahmi Kata Kabinet Arah Siasatan 'Mafia Korporat' — Tapi Biar SPRM Siasat Sendiri Dan Abaikan Seruan RCI
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 11 Mac, Menteri Komunikasi Datuk Fahmi Fadzil mengumumkan Kabinet telah mengarahkan agensi penguatkuasaan — termasuk polis (PDRM), Suruhanjaya Sekuriti (SC), Suruhanjaya Pencegahan Rasuah Malaysia (SPRM), dan Lembaga Hasil Dalam Negeri (LHDN) — menjalankan “siasatan terperinci” terhadap dakwaan rangkaian “mafia korporat” yang beroperasi dalam SPRM. Arahan ini dibuat beberapa minggu selepas Bloomberg menerbitkan siasatan bertajuk Who’s Watching Malaysia’s Anti-Corruption Watchdog? yang mendakwa pegawai SPRM menekan tokoh korporat dalam kes pengambilalihan syarikat. Yang jelas tidak disebut dalam pengumuman Fahmi: sebarang rujukan kepada Suruhanjaya Siasatan Diraja (RCI), walaupun semakin banyak seruan daripada ahli parlimen — termasuk Teresa Kok dari PH sendiri.

item.title: [BM] Fahmi Kata Kabinet Mahu Undang-Undang 3R Lebih Ketat — PH Janji Mansuh Undang-Undang Sekat Kebebasan Bersuara, Kini Tulis Yang Baru
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 11 Mac 2026, Menteri Komunikasi dan jurucakap kerajaan Fahmi Fadzil mengumumkan bahawa Kabinet telah memutuskan tindakan tegas mesti diambil terhadap isu 3R — kaum, agama, dan raja — termasuk di media sosial. Fahmi berkata kerajaan sedang mempertimbangkan untuk meminda undang-undang sedia ada atau memperkenalkan perundangan baru untuk menutup apa yang disifatkannya sebagai kelemahan yang membenarkan individu tertentu mengabaikan langkah penguatkuasaan.

item.title: [BM] Kabinet Akhirnya Bincang Laporan Azam Baki — Serah Keputusan Kepada KSN, Enggan Dedahkan Penemuan
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister / Cabinet

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 11 Mac 2026, Menteri Komunikasi Fahmi Fadzil mengumumkan bahawa Kabinet telah menerima dan membincangkan penemuan jawatankuasa khas — dipengerusikan oleh Peguam Negara Mohd Dusuki Mokhtar — yang menyiasat kontroversi pegangan saham ketua pesuruhjaya SPRM Azam Baki. Keputusan Kabinet: serahkan kepada Ketua Setiausaha Negara Tan Sri Shamsul Azri Abu Bakar untuk menentukan ’langkah seterusnya.’ Fahmi enggan mendedahkan kandungan laporan. Apabila ditanya secara langsung sama ada Kabinet membincangkan pelanjutan kontrak Azam, Fahmi berkata: ‘Ia tidak dibincangkan.’

item.title: [BM] Mohamad Hasan Kata Agensi Pelancongan Mesti Bawa Pulang Jemaah Umrah Terperangkap — 'Tak Boleh Serah Kerajaan Sahaja'
item.description:
Said by: Mohamad Hasan, Foreign Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Menteri Luar Negeri Datuk Seri Mohamad Hasan, bercakap pada sidang akhbar di Putrajaya pada 11 Mac, mengisytiharkan bahawa syarikat pelancongan dan agensi yang menguruskan pakej umrah mesti bertanggungjawab sepenuhnya membawa pulang jemaah yang terperangkap akibat konflik Asia Barat. Beliau berkata syarikat penerbangan juga mesti menghormati tiket mereka: ‘Jika tiket dengan Malaysia Airlines, MAS mesti bawa pulang. Jika tiket AirAsia, AirAsia mesti buat demikian.’ Beliau menambah tegas: ‘Ia tidak boleh diserahkan kepada kerajaan Malaysia sahaja.’ Ini pada hari yang sama penerbangan pemindahan pertama kerajaan — pesawat sewa Malaysia Airlines A330-300 — mendarat di KLIA dengan hanya 163 rakyat Malaysia dari Arab Saudi, Qatar, Jordan dan Syria.

item.title: [BM] Polis Soal Siasat Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif C4 Antirasuah Bawah Seksyen 124B — Kerajaan Anwar Guna Siasatan 'Komplot Guling' Untuk Gertak Masyarakat Sivil
item.description:
Said by: Bukit Aman (Royal Malaysia Police) / C4 Center (Pushpan Murugiah, CEO)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 10 Mac 2026, Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif Pusat Membanteras Rasuah dan Kronisme (C4) Pushpan Murugiah dipanggil ke Bukit Aman dan disoal siasat selama kira-kira 90 minit di bawah Seksyen 124B Kanun Keseksaan — aktiviti yang memudaratkan demokrasi berparlimen. Soal siasat itu dikaitkan dengan siasatan polis terhadap dakwaan komplot menggulingkan kerajaan. Tetapi soal siasat melangkaui e-mel tersebut. Polis mempersoalkan sumber pembiayaan C4, sama ada organisasi itu menerima arahan untuk mengeluarkan kenyataan, dan — yang mengejutkan — mencabar hak C4 untuk mengulas hal ehwal tadbir urus negara. C4 mengesahkan beberapa pengulas politik dan ahli akademik lain turut dipanggil ke Bukit Aman di bawah siasatan yang sama.

item.title: [BM] Ramanan Ugut 'Tindakan Tegas' Terhadap Kebebasan Bersuara, Kabinet Timbang Undang-Undang 3R Lebih Ketat — Gabungan Yang Janji Mansuh Akta Hasutan
item.description:
Said by: R. Ramanan, Human Resources Minister / Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 9 Mac 2026, Menteri Sumber Manusia Datuk Seri R. Ramanan mengeluarkan kenyataan memberi amaran bahawa kerajaan akan mengambil “tindakan tegas” terhadap sesiapa yang “sengaja mengancam keamanan negara,” khususnya berkaitan agama, kaum, dan raja (3R). Beliau kata kebebasan bersuara “tidak seharusnya disalahgunakan untuk menghasut atau memecahbelahkan masyarakat.” Dua hari kemudian, pada 11 Mac, Menteri Komunikasi Datuk Fahmi Fadzil mengesahkan Kabinet telah memutuskan “tindakan tegas perlu diambil terhadap isu 3R” dan kerajaan sedang aktif mempertimbangkan pindaan undang-undang sedia ada atau memperkenalkan undang-undang baharu yang lebih ketat. Menjelang 15 Mac, Timbalan Menteri Komunikasi Aaron Ago Dagang berkata semua kementerian akan memainkan peranan menangani isu 3R.

item.title: [BM] Sabah Tolak PH Di Peti Undi — Kini Mustapha Sakmud Kata Dia Suara Mereka Di Putrajaya
item.description:
Said by: Mustapha Sakmud, Sabah PH Chairman / Sabah and Sarawak Affairs Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 11 Mac 2026, Pengerusi PH Sabah dan Menteri Hal Ehwal Sabah dan Sarawak Mustapha Sakmud memberitahu FMT bahawa PH Sabah akan berperanan sebagai ‘saluran’ untuk memastikan isu negeri disuarakan di peringkat persekutuan. Beliau berkata beliau berhasrat memanfaatkan pelantikan menteri — dibuat pada 15 Februari — untuk membawa kebimbangan rakyat Sabah ke mesyuarat Kabinet.

item.title: Cabinet Finally Discusses Azam Baki Report — Punts Decision to Chief Secretary, Refuses to Reveal Findings
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister / Cabinet

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 11, 2026, Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil announced that Cabinet had received and discussed the findings of the special committee — chaired by Attorney General Mohd Dusuki Mokhtar — investigating MACC chief commissioner Azam Baki’s shareholding controversy. Cabinet’s decision: hand the matter to Chief Secretary to the Government Tan Sri Shamsul Azri Abu Bakar to determine “next steps.” Fahmi refused to disclose the report’s contents. When asked directly whether Cabinet discussed the extension of Azam’s contract, Fahmi said: “It was not discussed.” Separately, Cabinet instructed the police, Securities Commission, MACC itself, and the Inland Revenue Board to continue investigating Bloomberg’s “corporate mafia” allegations — including seizing proceeds believed to have criminal elements.

item.title: Fahmi Says Cabinet Orders 'Corporate Mafia' Probe — But Lets MACC Investigate Itself and Ignores RCI Calls
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 11, Communications Minister Datuk Fahmi Fadzil announced that the Cabinet had ordered enforcement agencies — including the police (PDRM), Securities Commission (SC), Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC), and Inland Revenue Board (LHDN) — to carry out a “detailed probe” into allegations of a “corporate mafia” network operating within MACC. The order came weeks after Bloomberg published a damning investigation titled Who’s Watching Malaysia’s Anti-Corruption Watchdog? alleging that MACC officers had pressured corporate figures in takeover cases. Notably absent from Fahmi’s announcement: any mention of a Royal Commission of Inquiry (RCI), despite growing calls from MPs — including PH’s own Teresa Kok.

item.title: Fahmi Says Cabinet Orders 'Thorough Probe' Into MACC Corporate Mafia — But an RCI? Don't Hold Your Breath
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister and Government Spokesman

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 11, Communications Minister and government spokesman Fahmi Fadzil told reporters after a Cabinet meeting that enforcement agencies — including the police, Securities Commission, MACC, and Inland Revenue Board — had been instructed to conduct a “thorough” investigation into allegations that certain MACC officials were involved in corporate takeover manoeuvres. Fahmi confirmed the Cabinet had received the special committee’s report on MACC chief Azam Baki’s shareholding scandal but refused to reveal its findings, saying further action would be taken by Chief Secretary Shamsul Azri Abu Bakar. When asked whether Azam’s contract extension was discussed, Fahmi said: “It was not discussed.”

item.title: Fahmi Says Cabinet Wants Stricter 3R Laws — PH Promised to Repeal Restrictive Speech Laws, Now They're Writing New Ones
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 11, 2026, Communications Minister and government spokesperson Fahmi Fadzil announced that Cabinet has decided firm action must be taken on 3R issues — race, religion, and royalty — including on social media. Fahmi said the government is considering amending existing laws or introducing new legislation to close what it describes as loopholes that allow certain individuals to ignore enforcement measures. He said the Attorney General has been directed to act decisively, and that the review would examine gaps in current laws that prevent early enforcement actions such as detentions.

item.title: Mohamad Hasan Says Travel Agencies Must Bring Home Stranded Umrah Pilgrims — 'It Cannot Be Left to the Government Alone'
item.description:
Said by: Mohamad Hasan, Foreign Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

Foreign Minister Datuk Seri Mohamad Hasan, speaking at a press conference in Putrajaya on March 11, declared that travel companies and agencies managing umrah packages must take full responsibility for bringing home pilgrims stranded by the West Asia conflict. He said airlines must also honour their tickets: ‘If the ticket is with Malaysia Airlines, MAS must bring them home. If it is an AirAsia ticket, AirAsia must do so.’ He added bluntly: ‘It cannot be left to the Malaysian government alone.’ This came the same day the government’s first evacuation flight — a chartered Malaysia Airlines A330-300 — landed at KLIA with just 163 Malaysians from Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Jordan and Syria, after days of airspace closures and flight disruptions across the Gulf.

item.title: PH Backbenchers Call for Snap Election Dressed Up as 'Reform' — Hold GE16 With All State Polls, Save Money, They Say
item.description:
Said by: Azli Yusof (Amanah-Shah Alam) / Jimmy Puah (PKR-Tebrau)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 11, two Pakatan Harapan backbenchers — Shah Alam MP Azli Yusof (Amanah) and Tebrau MP Jimmy Puah (PKR) — called for all state assembly elections to be held concurrently with the 16th General Election. Speaking to FMT, both MPs argued that separate elections lead to lower voter turnout, waste public money, and produce state governments with weaker mandates. Azli said separate polls are “unfair to voters, especially those who live far away from where they vote.” Puah called it “simply too tiring for people to come out and vote twice.” Putrajaya spent RM725 million on GE15 in 2022 and a further RM420 million on six subsequent state elections in 2023.

item.title: Police Question C4 Anti-Corruption CEO Under Section 124B — Anwar's Government Uses 'Plot to Topple' Probe to Interrogate Civil Society
item.description:
Said by: Bukit Aman (Royal Malaysia Police) / C4 Center (Pushpan Murugiah, CEO)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 10, 2026, the Center to Combat Corruption and Cronyism (C4) CEO Pushpan Murugiah was summoned to Bukit Aman and questioned for approximately 90 minutes under Section 124B of the Penal Code — activities detrimental to parliamentary democracy. The questioning was linked to the police investigation into an alleged plot to topple the government, reportedly because Pushpan’s name appeared in an email deemed relevant to the probe. But the interrogation went far beyond that email. Police questioned C4’s sources of funding, whether the organisation had received instructions to issue statements, and — remarkably — challenged C4’s right to comment on matters of national governance. C4 confirmed that several other political commentators and academics had also been summoned to Bukit Aman under the same investigation.

item.title: Ramanan Warns of 'Firm Action' on Free Speech, Cabinet Mulls Stricter 3R Laws — The Coalition That Promised to Repeal the Sedition Act
item.description:
Said by: R. Ramanan, Human Resources Minister / Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 9, 2026, Human Resources Minister Datuk Seri R. Ramanan issued a statement warning that the government would take “firm action” against anyone who “deliberately threatens national peace,” particularly on matters involving religion, race, and the monarchy (3R). He said freedom of speech “should not be misused to incite or divide society.” Two days later, on March 11, Communications Minister Datuk Fahmi Fadzil confirmed that the Cabinet had decided “firm action must be taken on matters related to 3R” and that the government was actively considering amending existing laws or introducing new, stricter legislation to tackle 3R issues. By March 15, Deputy Communications Minister Aaron Ago Dagang said all ministries would play a role in handling 3R matters.

item.title: Sabah Rejected PH at the Ballot Box — Now Mustapha Sakmud Says He'll Be Their Voice in Putrajaya Anyway
item.description:
Said by: Mustapha Sakmud, Sabah PH Chairman / Sabah and Sarawak Affairs Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 11, 2026, Sabah PH chairman and Sabah and Sarawak Affairs Minister Mustapha Sakmud told FMT that Sabah PH will serve as a “conduit” to ensure state issues are voiced at the federal level. He said he intends to leverage his ministerial appointment — made on February 15 — to bring Sabahan concerns to Cabinet meetings and government agencies. “This is the role we aim to play, and we hope the people of Sabah will appreciate it when their fundamental needs are addressed,” he said.

item.title: [BM] DAP Akhirnya Desak RCI Terhadap SPRM — Lambat Berminggu, Dan PAS Betul Panggil Ia Teater Politik
item.description:
Said by: DAP Leadership / Ahmad Fadhli Shaari, PAS Information Chief

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-10

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 10 Mac, DAP — parti terbesar dalam gabungan Pakatan Harapan dengan 40 kerusi parlimen — secara rasmi menuntut Suruhanjaya Siasatan Diraja (RCI) untuk menyiasat Suruhanjaya Pencegahan Rasuah Malaysia atas dakwaan yang pertama kali dilaporkan oleh Bloomberg, termasuk bahawa ketua SPRM Azam Baki melanggar had pegangan saham penjawat awam dan agensi itu terlibat dalam ugutan korporat. Ketua penerangan PAS Ahmad Fadhli Shaari menyifatkan tuntutan itu sebagai “teater politik,” menyatakan DAP berdiam diri apabila laporan Bloomberg yang sama mendakwa PM Anwar Ibrahim secara peribadi campur tangan dalam siasatan SPRM.

item.title: [BM] Rafizi Senyap-Senyap Tarik Balik Kes Bankrap NFCorp — Pejuang Antirasuah Berdamai Dengan Orang Yang Pernah Didedahkan
item.description:
Said by: Rafizi Ramli, Pandan MP / Former Economy Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-10

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Rafizi Ramli, MP Pandan dan bekas Menteri Ekonomi yang membina kerjaya politik atas pendedahan skandal Perbadanan Fidlot Nasional (NFCorp), telah secara senyap menarik balik prosiding kebankrapan dan penggulungannya terhadap pengarah NFCorp Datuk Seri Dr Mohamad Salleh Ismail dan syarikat itu sendiri. Notis Pemberhentian difailkan pada 3 Mac, dan Mahkamah Tinggi membatalkan kes pada 10 Mac tanpa perintah kos. Peguam Rafizi, Razlan Hadri Zulkifli, mengesahkan perkara itu “diselesaikan secara baik.” Kes ini berpunca daripada kos yang diperintahkan mahkamah kepada Rafizi selepas Mahkamah Persekutuan membenarkan rayuannya pada April 2022 — NFCorp dan Salleh membayar RM300,000 pada Disember 2022 tetapi berhenti membayar baki faedah tertunggak.

item.title: [BM] Ramanan Dakwa 'Ejen Berbayar' Dalang Ketegangan Kaum — Janji Tindakan Kabinet Bukan Selesaikan Punca
item.description:
Said by: R. Ramanan, Human Resources Minister / Aaron Ago Dagang, National Unity Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-10

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Menteri Sumber Manusia dan Naib Presiden PKR Datuk Seri R. Ramanan mengadakan sidang akhbar khas di Putrajaya pada 9 Mac diiringi pegawai PKR, mendakwa “ejen provokasi” dibayar untuk mencetuskan ketegangan kaum dan agama di Malaysia. Beliau berkata perkara itu akan dibangkitkan di Kabinet pada 11 Mac, dan tangkapan sudah dibuat. Menteri Perpaduan Negara Aaron Ago Dagang menyokong seruan itu pada 10 Mac. Kedua-dua menteri tidak menamakan provokator yang didakwa atau pembiaya mereka.

item.title: DAP Finally Demands RCI on MACC — Weeks Late, and PAS Correctly Calls It Political Theatre
item.description:
Said by: DAP Leadership / Ahmad Fadhli Shaari, PAS Information Chief

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-10

📌 What Happened

On March 10, DAP — the largest party in the Pakatan Harapan coalition with 40 parliamentary seats — formally called for a Royal Commission of Inquiry (RCI) to investigate the Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission over allegations first reported by Bloomberg, including that MACC chief Azam Baki breached civil servant shareholding limits and that the agency was involved in corporate intimidation. PAS information chief Ahmad Fadhli Shaari responded by calling the demand “political theatre,” noting that DAP had remained silent when the same Bloomberg reports alleged that Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim personally interfered in MACC investigations.

item.title: Rafizi Quietly Drops NFCorp Bankruptcy Bid — The Anti-Corruption Crusader Makes Nice With the People He Once Exposed
item.description:
Said by: Rafizi Ramli, Pandan MP / Former Economy Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-10

📌 What Happened

Rafizi Ramli, the Pandan MP and former Economy Minister who built his political career on exposing the National Feedlot Corporation (NFCorp) scandal, has quietly dropped his bankruptcy and winding-up proceedings against NFCorp director Datuk Seri Dr Mohamad Salleh Ismail and the company itself. A Notice of Discontinuance was filed on March 3, and the High Court struck out the case on March 10 without an order as to costs. Rafizi’s lawyer Razlan Hadri Zulkifli confirmed the matter was “amicably resolved.” The case stemmed from court-ordered costs owed to Rafizi after the Federal Court upheld his appeal in April 2022 — NFCorp and Salleh had paid RM300,000 in December 2022 but stopped paying the outstanding interest balance.

item.title: Ramanan Claims 'Paid Agents' Are Behind Racial Tensions — Promises Cabinet Crackdown Instead of Addressing Root Causes
item.description:
Said by: R. Ramanan, Human Resources Minister / Aaron Ago Dagang, National Unity Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-10

📌 What Happened

Human Resources Minister and PKR Vice-President Datuk Seri R. Ramanan held a special press conference in Putrajaya on March 9 flanked by PKR officials, claiming that “agents of provocation” are being paid to incite racial and religious tensions in Malaysia. He said the matter would be raised at Cabinet on March 11, and that arrests have already been made. National Unity Minister Aaron Ago Dagang echoed the call on March 10, urging police to “take stern action” against anyone disrupting harmony. Neither minister named the alleged provocateurs or their financiers — Ramanan specifically said he would not name them to avoid “making them famous.”

item.title: [BM] Anwar Arah Kenaikan Pangkat Beramai-ramai 125,000 Penjawat Awam — Semasa Penjimatan, Menjelang Pilihan Raya, Selepas Kursus 2 Minggu

Satu-satunya syarat: menamatkan kursus latihan dua hingga tiga minggu meliputi kemahiran IT asas. Anwar mengarahkan Ketua Setiausaha Negara Shamsul Azri Abu Bakar dan JPA memastikan semua 125,000 kenaikan pangkat diproses dalam tempoh enam bulan.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Kutuk Serangan Iran Ke Atas Kuwait — Berminggu Selepas Usul Parlimen Mempertahankan Iran Terhadap Serangan AS-Israel
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 9 Mac 2026, Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim menelefon Perdana Menteri Kuwait, Sheikh Ahmad Abdullah Al-Ahmad Al-Sabah, untuk mengutuk serangan Iran yang menyasarkan Kuwait. Beliau menyatakan takziah atas korban dan mengesahkan sokongan Malaysia terhadap keselamatan dan integriti wilayah Kuwait. Panggilan telefon ini datang tepat seminggu selepas Anwar membentangkan usul tergempar di Parlimen pada 2 Mac mengutuk serangan AS-Israel ke atas Iran, yang mana beliau mengisytiharkan Malaysia ’tidak lagi mampu menelan’ kuliah hak asasi Barat dan ahli parlimen belakang PH Syahredzan Johan menyeru AP memboikot semua acara kedutaan AS.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Taknak Gantung Azam Baki — Biar Saja Kontrak Tamat Mei Sementara Negara Terbakar
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister / Straits Times sources

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

The Straits Times melaporkan pada 9 Mac 2026 — memetik sumber kerajaan dan undang-undang peringkat tinggi — bahawa PM Anwar Ibrahim telah memutuskan tidak memperbaharui tempoh ketua pesuruhjaya SPRM Tan Sri Azam Baki apabila ia tamat pada 12 Mei 2026. Tetapi Anwar tidak menggantung Azam sekarang. Beliau tidak mengarahkan siasatan awam bebas. Beliau hanya akan membiarkan masa habis — dua bulan lagi ketua antirasuah yang dituduh mengetuai “mafia korporat.” Ini selepas Bloomberg melaporkan SPRM di bawah Azam menyalahguna kuasa untuk memeras ugut dan memanipulasi tokoh korporat; Azam didapati melanggar peraturan pegangan saham penjawat awam berkali-kali; Rafizi Ramli dan 8 MP PKR menuntut penggantungan segera Azam; Bersih menuntut peletakan jawatan; dan perhimpunan 15 Feb di KL menuntut tangkapan Azam.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Ulang 'Bantuan Berdasar Keperluan, Bukan Kaum' Di Dewan Negara — Skrip Sama, Sesi Lain, Sifar Perubahan Struktur
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

Perdana Menteri Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim memberitahu Dewan Negara pada 9 Mac 2026 bahawa bantuan kerajaan diperuntukkan berdasarkan keperluan, bukan kaum. Beliau menegaskan kerajaan Madani akan “kekal adil kepada semua negeri” dan bantuan menyasarkan mereka yang paling memerlukan tanpa mengira latar belakang. Ini bukan kali pertama Anwar menggunakan ayat yang sama. Pada Ogos 2025, beliau memberitahu Dewan Negara yang sama perkara yang sama — hampir perkataan demi perkataan.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Ulang 'Bantuan Berdasarkan Keperluan, Bukan Kaum' Di Dewan Negara — Skrip Sama, Sidang Lain, Sifar Perubahan Struktur

Beliau menegaskan kerajaan Madani akan “kekal adil kepada semua negeri” dan bantuan menyasarkan golongan paling memerlukan tanpa mengira latar belakang.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Umum 125,000 Kenaikan Pangkat Penjawat Awam Dari Gred 1 Ke Gred 5 — Kursus Dua Minggu Dan Naik Gaji Sebelum Pilihan Raya
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim mengumumkan pada 9 Mac 2026 bahawa 125,000 penjawat awam berpangkat rendah di Gred 1 akan dinaikkan ke Gred 5 bermula Januari 2027. Syarat satu-satunya: selesaikan kursus latihan dua hingga tiga minggu meliputi kemahiran IT dan kompetensi lain. Anwar mengarahkan Jabatan Perkhidmatan Awam (JPA) untuk merangka butiran lanjut. Pengumuman ini dibuat dalam minggu yang sama dengan bonus RM500 penjawat awam, bantuan tunai STR RM15 bilion yang dipercepatkan sebelum Hari Raya, dan bayaran RM500 kepada 70,000 kakitangan masjid dan agama.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Umum Kenaikan Pangkat 125,000 Penjawat Awam Dari Gred 1 Ke Gred 5 — Kursus Dua Minggu Dan Kenaikan Gaji Sebelum Pilihan Raya

item.title: [BM] AP PKR Sendiri Amaran Anwar Berisiko Hilang Legitimasi Kerana Abaikan Nurul Izzah Dan Ahli Parlimen Belakang Soal SPRM
item.description:

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 9 Mac 2026, AP PKR Pasir Gudang Hassan Abdul Karim secara terbuka memberi amaran kepada Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim bahawa mengabaikan kebimbangan yang dibangkitkan oleh ahli parlimen dan timbalan presiden PKR Nurul Izzah Anwar mengenai SPRM meletakkan legitimasi PM dalam risiko. Bercakap kepada Malaysiakini, Hassan berkata Anwar tidak boleh terus berpura-pura pekak terhadap kebimbangan dalaman parti, terutamanya selepas Nurul Izzah menggesa SPRM diletakkan di bawah pengawasan parlimen.

item.title: [BM] DAP Percepatkan Kongres Ke Julai — Undi Sama Ada Pemimpin Patut Keluar Kerajaan, Tapi Janji Kekal Juga
item.description:
Said by: Anthony Loke, DAP Secretary-General / Transport Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

DAP, parti komponen terbesar dalam gabungan Pakatan Harapan Anwar mengikut kerusi parlimen, telah mempercepatkan kongres kebangsaannya dari September ke 12 Julai 2026. Di kongres, lebih 4,000 perwakilan akan mengundi dalam referendum dalaman sama ada pemimpin parti patut meletak jawatan daripada jawatan kerajaan. Setiausaha agung DAP dan Menteri Pengangkutan Anthony Loke memberitahu Malaysiakini bahawa “tindak balas kerajaan tidak memadai dan tidak memenuhi jangkaan rakyat” berhubung skandal SPRM.

item.title: [BM] Keluarga Daim Saman Kerajaan Anwar Atas Dakwaan 'Komplot Zionis' — Kata Siasatan Polis Tidak Sah Dan Bertentangan Perlembagaan
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister / Daim Zainuddin’s Family (Respondents)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

Keluarga bekas menteri kewangan Daim Zainuddin — balunya Naimah Abdul Khalid, dua anak lelaki, dan dua peguam keluarga — memfailkan saman di Mahkamah Tinggi Kuala Lumpur pada 7 Mac 2026, menuntut pengisytiharan bahawa siasatan polis terhadap dakwaan komplot menjatuhkan kerajaan Anwar adalah tidak sah, bertentangan perlembagaan, dan dicemari niat jahat. Ini berikutan Anwar memberitahu Parlimen pada 3 Mac bahawa seorang suspek dalam konspirasi yang didakwa telah melantik firma PR antarabangsa untuk melancarkan serangan terselaras terhadap institusi negara, mendakwa komplot itu melibatkan ‘kumpulan Zionis terkemuka,’ pelobi asing, bankir, dan agensi media antarabangsa.

Keluarga mendiang bekas menteri kewangan Daim Zainuddin — isterinya Naimah Abdul Khalid, dua anak lelaki, dan dua peguam keluarga — memfailkan saman di Mahkamah Tinggi Kuala Lumpur pada 7 Mac 2026, memohon pengisytiharan bahawa siasatan polis terhadap dakwaan komplot menggulingkan kerajaan Anwar adalah tidak sah, tidak berperlembagaan, dan tercemar oleh niat jahat. item.title: [BM] Menteri Sukan Kata 'Ambil Pengajaran Dan Teruskan' Dari Skandal Pemain Warisan — Mana Akauntabiliti Kerajaan?
item.description:
Said by: Dr. Mohammed Taufiq Johari, Youth and Sports Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 9 Mac 2026, Menteri Belia dan Sukan Dr. Mohammed Taufiq Johari menyeru Persatuan Bola Sepak Malaysia (FAM) untuk “mengambil pengajaran” daripada skandal pemain warisan dan bergerak ke hadapan dengan pembangunan bola sepak akar umbi. Mahkamah Timbang Tara Sukan (CAS) mengesahkan sanksi FIFA terhadap tujuh pemain yang didapati menggunakan dokumen palsu untuk mewakili Malaysia di peringkat antarabangsa. Kesemua tujuh menerima penggantungan 12 bulan. FIFA juga membatalkan keputusan tiga perlawanan antarabangsa dan mendenda FAM CHF350,000 (RM1.8 juta). Yang penting: tiada seorang pun daripada tujuh pemain itu mempunyai akar Malaysia. Label “pemain warisan” itu sendiri adalah rekaan.

item.title: [BM] MP PKR Sendiri Amaran Anwar Berisiko Hilang Legitimasi Kerana Abaikan Nurul Izzah Dan Ahli Parlimen Belakang Soal SPRM
item.description:
Said by: Hassan Abdul Karim, PKR MP for Pasir Gudang

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

Bercakap kepada Malaysiakini, Hassan berkata Anwar tidak boleh terus menutup telinga terhadap kebimbangan dalaman parti mengenai kelakuan SPRM, terutama selepas Nurul Izzah menyeru agensi itu diletakkan di bawah pengawasan parlimen.

item.title: [BM] Pengkhianatan Muktamad: Anwar Bina Harapan, Jual Kepada UMNO, Dan Panggil Ia Reformasi
item.description:
Said by: Compilation: CSIS, Toda, CNA, East Asia Forum, ISEAS, Amnesty, HRW, Freedom House

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Selepas tiga tahun berkuasa, keputusan daripada badan pemerhati antarabangsa, badan pemikir, dan penganalisis adalah sebulat suara: Anwar Ibrahim gagal menyampaikan agenda reformasinya.

  • CSIS: ‘Kematian Reformasi.’
  • Institut Keamanan Toda: ‘Memburukkan keadaan.’
  • Amnesty International: ‘Mengkhianati ikrar reformasi.’
  • HRW: ‘Agenda reformasi terhenti.’
  • Freedom House: ‘Separa Bebas’ (tidak berubah).
  • CNA: ‘Ribut sempurna’ krisis.
  • East Asia Forum: ‘Aspirasi reformasi bertembung dengan realiti politik.’
  • ISEAS: ‘Memerlukan ketegasan, keadilan dan kesedaran diri.’ 🔥 KENAPA IA PENTING: Ini bukan seorang pengkritik, satu perspektif, atau satu serangan partisan. Ini adalah KONSENSUS merentas institusi paling dihormati di dunia bahawa projek reformasi Anwar telah gagal. Apabila CSIS di Washington, Amnesty di London, ISEAS di Singapura, Toda di Tokyo, dan Freedom House semuanya mencapai kesimpulan yang sama secara bebas, ia bukan berat sebelah — ia kebenaran.

💩 KENAPA IA KARUT: Anwar mempunyai SEGALANYA: naratif peribadi penderitaan, gerakan dibina atas harapan, mandat pengundi, bilangan parlimen, muhibah antarabangsa, dan pengalaman berdekad. Beliau mempunyai lebih banyak modal politik daripada mana-mana PM yang masuk dalam sejarah Malaysia. Dan beliau membelanjakan SEMUANYA untuk mengekalkan kuasa melalui rangkaian naungan UMNO dan bukannya menyampaikan reformasi yang mewajarkan keseluruhan kewujudan politiknya. Ini bukan kegagalan keadaan — ini kegagalan watak.

item.title: [BM] Ramanan Ugut 'Tindakan Tegas' Atas Kebebasan Bersuara — Janji Reformasi PH Hanya Bertahan Sehingga Ada Yang Berani Bersuara

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

Ramanan mengeluarkan kenyataan awam memberi amaran bahawa kerajaan akan mengambil “tindakan tegas” terhadap sesiapa yang “sengaja mengancam keamanan negara,” khususnya dalam isu agama, kaum, dan raja — dikenali sebagai isu 3R. Ramanan berkata terdapat “peningkatan yang membimbangkan dalam kenyataan, posting media sosial dan komen dalam talian bertujuan mencetuskan ketegangan kaum” dan memberi amaran bahawa “kebebasan bersuara tidak boleh disalahguna untuk menghasut atau memecahbelahkan masyarakat.” Keesokan harinya, beliau memberitahu wartawan akan membawa isu “provokator” yang tidak dinamakan ke mesyuarat Kabinet 11 Mac. Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi Steven Sim turut menggesa polis “bertindak tegas terhadap semua pelaku.”
