item.title: Anwar Announces 125,000 Civil Servant Promotions From Grade 1 to Grade 5 — A Two-Week Course and a Pay Bump Before the Election
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 What Happened

Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim announced on March 9, 2026 that 125,000 lower-ranked civil servants currently at Grade 1 will be promoted to Grade 5 starting January 2027. The only requirement: completing a two-to-three-week training course covering IT skills and other competencies. Anwar directed the Public Service Department (PSD) to work out the details. This announcement came during the same week as the RM500 civil servant bonuses, the RM15 billion STR cash handouts brought forward before Hari Raya, and the RM500 payments to 70,000 mosque and religious personnel.

item.title: Anwar Condemns Iran's Attacks on Kuwait — Weeks After Parliament Motion Defending Iran Against US-Israel Strikes
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 What Happened

On March 9, 2026, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim called the Prime Minister of Kuwait, Sheikh Ahmad Abdullah Al-Ahmad Al-Sabah, to condemn Iranian attacks targeting Kuwait. He expressed condolences for the casualties and affirmed Malaysia’s support for Kuwait’s security and territorial integrity. This phone call came exactly one week after Anwar tabled an emergency motion in Parliament on March 2 condemning US-Israel strikes on Iran, during which he declared that Malaysia could ’no longer swallow’ Western human rights lectures and PH backbencher Syahredzan Johan called on MPs to boycott all US embassy events.

item.title: Anwar Orders Mass Promotion of 125,000 Civil Servants — During Austerity, Ahead of Elections, After a 2-Week Course
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 What Happened

On March 9, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim announced at the Ministry of Domestic Trade and Cost of Living (KPDN) assembly in Putrajaya that 125,000 Grade 1 civil servants — administrative, clerical, and financial assistants — will be promoted to Grade 5 effective January 2027. The only requirement: complete a two-to-three-week training course covering basic IT skills. Anwar directed Chief Secretary Shamsul Azri Abu Bakar and the Public Service Department (PSD) to ensure all 125,000 promotions are processed within six months.

item.title: Anwar Repeats 'Aid Based on Need, Not Race' in Dewan Negara — Same Script, Different Session, Zero Structural Change
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 WHAT HAPPENED

Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim told the Dewan Negara on March 9, 2026, that government aid and assistance are allocated based on need, not race. He affirmed that the Madani government would “remain fair to all states” and that assistance targets those most in need regardless of background.

This is not the first time Anwar has used this exact line. In August 2025, he told the same Dewan Negara the same thing — almost word for word — as reported by The Star and NST. Before that, the 13th Malaysia Plan (13MP) was framed around the same “needs-based, not race-based” rhetoric.

item.title: Anwar Won't Suspend Azam Baki — Will Just Let His Contract Expire in May While the Country Burns
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister / Straits Times sources

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: The Straits Times reported on March 9, 2026 — citing high-level government and legal sources — that Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim has decided not to renew MACC chief commissioner Tan Sri Azam Baki’s tenure when it expires on May 12, 2026. This would mark the end of Azam’s fourth annual extension since reaching retirement age in 2023. According to the report, Anwar has “repeatedly stressed to Cabinet in recent weeks that Azam won’t be renewed.” But crucially, Anwar is not suspending Azam now. He is not ordering an independent public inquiry. He is not referring the matter to Parliament. He is simply going to let the clock run out — two more months of an anti-corruption chief accused of being the head of a “corporate mafia.” This comes after Bloomberg reported that the MACC under Azam had abused its powers to extort and manipulate corporate figures; Azam was found to have breached civil servant shareholding rules multiple times, most recently in January 2026, holding 17.7 million shares in Velocity Capital Bhd; former Economy Minister Rafizi Ramli and 8 PKR MPs publicly demanded Azam’s immediate suspension; Bersih demanded resignation and organised protests; DAP Secretary-General Anthony Loke called the government’s response “inadequate”; and a Feb 15 rally in Kuala Lumpur demanded Azam’s arrest.

item.title: Daim's Family Sues Anwar's Government Over 'Zionist Plot' Claims — Calls Police Probe Unlawful and Unconstitutional
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister / Daim Zainuddin’s Family (Respondents)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 What Happened

The family of late former finance minister Daim Zainuddin — his widow Naimah Abdul Khalid, two sons, and two family lawyers — filed a lawsuit at the Kuala Lumpur High Court on March 7, 2026, seeking a declaration that the police investigation into the alleged plot to topple Anwar’s government is unlawful, unconstitutional, and tainted by bad faith. This comes after Anwar told Parliament on March 3 that a suspect in the alleged conspiracy had engaged an international PR firm to launch coordinated attacks on national institutions, claiming the plot involved ‘a prominent Zionist group,’ foreign lobbyists, bankers, and international media agencies.

item.title: DAP Brings Forward Congress to July — Will Vote on Whether Leaders Should Quit Government, But Promises to Stay Anyway
item.description:
Said by: Anthony Loke, DAP Secretary-General / Transport Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 What Happened

DAP, the largest component party in Anwar’s Pakatan Harapan coalition by parliamentary seats, has brought forward its national congress from September to July 12, 2026. At the congress, more than 4,000 delegates will vote in an internal referendum on whether party leaders should resign from their government posts. DAP secretary-general and Transport Minister Anthony Loke told Malaysiakini on February 24 that “the government’s response has been inadequate and does not meet public expectations” regarding the MACC scandal. The move comes after DAP lost every seat it contested in November’s Sabah state polls and faces mounting grassroots anger over stalled reforms, the MACC crisis, and the perception that DAP is enabling a government that has abandoned its own platform.

item.title: PKR's Own MP Warns Anwar Risks Legitimacy by Ignoring Nurul Izzah and Backbenchers on MACC
item.description:
Said by: Hassan Abdul Karim, PKR MP for Pasir Gudang

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 What Happened

On 9 March 2026, PKR’s Pasir Gudang MP Hassan Abdul Karim publicly warned Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim — his own party president — that ignoring concerns raised by MPs and PKR deputy president Nurul Izzah Anwar about the Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC) puts the PM’s legitimacy at risk. Speaking to Malaysiakini, Hassan said Anwar cannot keep turning a deaf ear to internal party concerns about the MACC’s conduct, particularly after Nurul Izzah called for the agency to be placed under parliamentary oversight and criticised the “high-handed manner” of investigations including the RM1.1 billion Arm Holdings deal probe.

item.title: Ramanan Threatens 'Firm Action' Over Free Speech — PH's Reform Promise Lasts Until Someone Uses It
item.description:
Said by: R. Ramanan, Human Resources Minister and PKR Vice-President

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 What Happened

On March 9, 2026, Human Resources Minister and PKR Vice-President Datuk Seri R. Ramanan issued a public statement warning that the government will take “firm action” against anyone who “deliberately threatens national peace,” particularly on matters involving religion, race, and the monarchy — the so-called 3R issues. Ramanan said there has been “a worrying rise in statements, social media posts and online comments aimed at provoking racial tensions” and warned that “freedom of speech should not be misused to incite or divide society.” The following day, he told reporters he would personally raise the issue of unnamed “provocateurs” at the March 11 Cabinet meeting. Entrepreneur and Cooperative Development Minister Steven Sim echoed the call, demanding police “act firmly against all perpetrators.”

item.title: Sports Minister Says 'Learn Lessons and Move On' From Heritage Player Scandal — Where's the Government Accountability?

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

On March 9, 2026, Youth and Sports Minister Dr. Mohammed Taufiq Johari called on the Football Association of Malaysia (FAM) to “take lessons” from the heritage player scandal and move forward with grassroots football development.

“The legal process has taken place and we accept the decision that has been made. We will now examine what follow-up steps need to be taken,” Taufiq said at an Iftar Ramadan event in Tikam Batu.

item.title: The Ultimate Betrayal: Anwar Built Hope, Sold It to UMNO, and Called It Reform
item.description:
Said by: Compilation: CSIS, Toda, CNA, East Asia Forum, ISEAS, Amnesty, HRW, Freedom House

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-09

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: After three years in power, the verdict from international watchdogs, think tanks, and analysts is unanimous: Anwar Ibrahim has failed to deliver on his reform agenda.

  • CSIS: ‘The Death of Reformasi.’
  • Toda Peace Institute: ‘Making things worse.’
  • Amnesty International: ‘Betrayed reform pledges.’
  • HRW: ‘Reform agenda stalled.’
  • Freedom House: ‘Partly Free’ (unchanged).
  • CNA: ‘Perfect storm’ of crises.
  • East Asia Forum: ‘Reform aspirations clashed with political realities.’
  • ISEAS: ‘Needs rigour, fairness and self-awareness.’ 🔥 WHY IT MATTERS: This is not one critic, one perspective, or one partisan attack. This is a CONSENSUS across the world’s most respected institutions that Anwar’s reform project has failed. When CSIS in Washington, Amnesty in London, ISEAS in Singapore, Toda in Tokyo, and Freedom House all reach the same conclusion independently, it’s not bias — it’s the truth.

💩 WHY IT’S BULLSHIT: Anwar had EVERYTHING: a personal narrative of suffering, a movement built on hope, a mandate from voters, parliamentary numbers, international goodwill, and decades of experience. He had more political capital than any incoming PM in Malaysian history. And he spent it ALL on maintaining power through UMNO’s patronage network rather than delivering the reforms that justified his entire political existence. This isn’t a failure of circumstance — it’s a failure of character.

🔥 MENGAPA IA PENTING: Seluruh premis Pakatan Harapan ialah ia mewakili alternatif kepada ekstremisme agama PAS dan naungan etno-nasionalis UMNO. Kesediaan Anwar mendekati PAS — walaupun DAP, rakan gabungan paling setianya, sedang kehilangan sokongan — isyarat bahawa kelangsungan pilihan raya telah mengatasi ideologi sepenuhnya. Jika PH dibina untuk menentang PAS, dan pemimpin PH kini mendekati PAS, apa sebenarnya yang diperjuangkan PH lagi?

Rafizi menjawab bahawa maksud komennya “boleh difahami oleh sesiapa yang mahir bahasa Melayu” dan beliau bebas membuat rancangan sendiri selepas Parlimen dibubarkan. Pada 6 Mac, PKR menyampaikan keputusannya melalui emel — tiada tindakan diambil, hanya peringatan mematuhi perlembagaan parti dan kod etika. Pada 8 Mac, Rafizi secara terbuka menggambarkan ini sebagai “pusingan U,” berkata surat tunjuk sebab dikeluarkan “dengan niat memberikan beliau tendangan” tetapi parti akhirnya gentar.

item.title: Anwar Claims PKR's 2016 US Lobbying Was 'Only About His Release' — 84-Page Dossier Shows It Called for Washington to Intervene Against Malaysia
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister / Nurul Izzah Anwar, PKR Deputy President / Sivarasa Rasiah, PKR Senior Leader

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-08

📌 What Happened

On March 8, MalaysiaNow published details of an 84-page dossier titled White Paper on the case of Anwar Ibrahim: Citizen of Malaysia v. Government of Malaysia, prepared jointly by PKR’s Sivarasa Rasiah and American consultant Jared Genser of Perseus Strategies in April 2016. The document, which a senior PKR MP confirmed was delivered to several US Congress members, called on the Obama administration to take a greater interest in Malaysia’s domestic politics, publicly rebuke the Najib government, and demand Anwar’s release. Anwar had previously stated that PKR’s hiring of Genser was “solely to press for his release from prison.”

item.title: PKR Issues Show-Cause Letter to Rafizi, Then Backs Down — Party Can't Even Discipline Its Most Prominent Critic
item.description:
Said by: Rafizi Ramli, Pandan MP / Fuziah Salleh, PKR Secretary-General

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-08

📌 What Happened

On February 19, Pandan MP Rafizi Ramli revealed he had received a show-cause letter from PKR secretary-general Fuziah Salleh after telling Sin Chew Daily he would contest in Pandan at GE16 but likely not as a PKR candidate. Rafizi responded saying the meaning of his comments was “understandable to anyone with a good command of Malay” and that he was free to make his own plans after Parliament was dissolved. On March 6, PKR conveyed its decision by email — no action taken, just a reminder to adhere to the party constitution and code of ethics. On March 8, Rafizi publicly described this as a “U-turn,” saying the show-cause letter was issued “with the intention to give him the boot” but the party ultimately blinked.

item.title: Teresa Kok Says Coalition Unity More Important Than RCI Into MACC — DAP's Own MP Undermines the Accountability Push

This came just days after DAP secretary-general Anthony Loke told Malaysiakini the government’s response to MACC misconduct allegations had been “inadequate” and called for an independent inquiry — a position endorsed by DAP’s national leadership and reinforced by the party’s decision to bring forward its special congress to July 2026.

Beliau mengesahkan akan mempertahankan kerusi parlimen Pandan dalam pilihan raya umum seterusnya tetapi pasti bukan di bawah bendera PKR. item.title: Anwar Warns of 'Wealthy Elites' Manipulating Media — While His Own Government Shields the MACC Chief From Accountability
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-07

📌 What Happened

On March 7, 2026, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim used an iftar event in Kulim to accuse unnamed Malaysian elites of “corruptly using their wealth to exert influence on international media, online narratives and local politics.” He said he was not referring only to the opposition but to “everyone,” and urged Malaysians to “remain vigilant” against “foreign schemes and conspiracies.” The statement came just four days after he told Parliament about an alleged plot — involving a former senior minister’s wife, foreign PR firms, and Bloomberg — to destabilise his government.

item.title: Anwar's 'Perfect Storm': Anti-Graft Crisis, Party Fractures, Coalition Jitters
item.description:
Said by: CNA Analysis

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-07

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Multiple challenges are converging on Anwar Ibrahim that may force him to call early elections nearly two years ahead of the February 2028 deadline. An anti-graft crisis at MACC (Bloomberg exposés on Azam Baki), PKR internal fractures following Rafizi Ramli’s departure from cabinet, and coalition partners openly reconsidering their ties. CNA described it as a “perfect storm” of political instability. UMNO’s secret Bangkok meeting with opposition parties, DAP reviewing coalition ties, and the PKR factional war all threaten to bring down the Unity Government before its term ends.

item.title: Rafizi Tells PH Voters to 'Wait Till June' — Hints at Breaking Away from PKR and 'Sailing His Own Ship'
item.description:
Said by: Rafizi Ramli, Pandan MP / Former Economy Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-07

📌 What Happened

Former Economy Minister Rafizi Ramli, who quit the cabinet in May 2025 after losing the PKR deputy presidency contest, told Pakatan Harapan supporters in a Sin Chew Daily interview to “wait till June,” hinting that a new political option would be unveiled. Rafizi said he and his allies are open to “sailing their own ship” and are exploring “different political configurations” — which could involve a new party, coalition, or political platform. He confirmed he will defend his Pandan parliamentary seat in the next general election but definitively not under the PKR banner. Separately, Reuters reported that several PKR lawmakers are considering contesting as independents, having lost confidence in Anwar’s leadership.

item.title: [BM] 238 Pelantikan Politik Ke Badan Berkanun Dan GLC Di Bawah Anwar — Laporan IDEAS Dedah 'Kenalan Mengatasi Kecekapan'
item.description:
Said by: IDEAS Report / Anwar Ibrahim Administration

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-06

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Institut Demokrasi dan Hal Ehwal Ekonomi (IDEAS) mengeluarkan laporan bertajuk Who Sits at the Table: From Political to Public Appointees in Malaysia’s Federal Statutory Bodies pada 6 Mac 2026, mendedahkan bahawa 238 pelantikan politik dibuat ke badan berkanun persekutuan (FSB) dan syarikat berkaitan kerajaan (GLC) di bawah pentadbiran Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim antara November 2022 dan Oktober 2025. Daripada jumlah ini, 222 ke FSB dan 16 ke GLC. Laporan itu mengkaji 135 agensi dan mendapati 78% jawatan pengerusi diisi berdasarkan hubungan politik dan bukannya kecekapan. Kebanyakan tidak mempunyai kriteria kelayakan yang jelas.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Nafi Pilihan Raya Kilat Pada Disember — Kini Kerajaannya Senyap-Senyap Bersedia Untuk Pilihan Raya 2026

Mara pantas ke Mac 2026: pelbagai orang dalam kerajaan, pemimpin akar umbi parti, dan penjawat awam memberitahu CNA bahawa persediaan sedang berjalan secara senyap untuk kemungkinan pilihan raya umum pada separuh kedua 2026. Ahli politik Johor dari kerajaan perpaduan berkata akar umbi telah diberitahu untuk meningkatkan persediaan selepas Hari Raya Aidilfitri. Penjawat awam kanan mengesahkan pegawai pentadbiran kerajaan telah diletakkan dalam keadaan berwaspada dan sumber ditetapkan “dalam keadaan bersedia” dari Jun. Timbalan Pengerusi SPR Azmi Sharom berkata suruhanjaya bersedia, termasuk untuk pilihan raya negeri dan parlimen serentak.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Nafikan Pilihan Raya Kilat Pada Disember — Kini Kerajaannya Senyap-Senyap Bersiap Sedia Untuk Pilihan Raya 2026
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister / Unity Government sources

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-06

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada Disember 2025, Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim memberitahu wartawan bahawa pilihan raya kilat tidak dalam perancangan — keutamaannya, katanya, adalah melaksanakan reformasi dan menangani kos sara hidup. Maju pantas ke Mac 2026: pelbagai orang dalam kerajaan, pemimpin akar umbi parti, dan penjawat awam memberitahu CNA bahawa persediaan sedang dijalankan secara senyap untuk kemungkinan pilihan raya umum pada separuh kedua 2026. Ahli politik Johor dari kerajaan perpaduan berkata akar umbi telah diberitahu meningkatkan persediaan selepas Hari Raya Aidilfitri. Penjawat awam kanan mengesahkan pegawai pentadbiran kerajaan telah disiapsiagakan dan sumber “sedia” dari Jun. Timbalan pengerusi SPR Azmi Sharom berkata suruhanjaya itu sedia.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Suruh Bersih Berhenti Kritik SPRM 'Semasa Ramadan' — Guna Bulan Suci Sebagai Perisai Terhadap Akauntabiliti
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-06

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 6 Mac 2026, Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim secara terbuka menolak tuduhan Gabungan Pilihan Raya Bersih dan Adil (Bersih) bahawa Suruhanjaya Pencegahan Rasuah Malaysia (SPRM) telah menjadi alat politik kerajaan. Berucap selepas program Ihya’ Ramadan Jabatan Perkhidmatan Awam di Putrajaya, Anwar memanggil kenyataan Bersih “tidak adil” dan berkata kumpulan itu “tidak membuat kenyataan bersih.” Beliau kemudian menambah: “Jangan serang orang tanpa terlebih dahulu mendapatkan maklumat, terutama semasa Ramadan.”

item.title: 238 Political Appointments to FSBs and GLCs Under Anwar — IDEAS Report Exposes 'Connections Over Competence'
item.description:
Said by: IDEAS Report / Anwar Ibrahim Administration

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-06

📌 What Happened

The Institute for Democracy and Economic Affairs (IDEAS) released a report titled Who Sits at the Table: From Political to Public Appointees in Malaysia’s Federal Statutory Bodies on March 6, 2026, revealing that 238 political appointments were made to federal statutory bodies (FSBs) and government-linked companies (GLCs) under Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s administration between November 2022 and October 2025. Of these, 222 were to FSBs and 16 to GLCs. The report reviewed 135 agencies and found that 78% of chairperson positions were filled based on political connections rather than competence. Most lacked clearly defined qualification criteria. The appointments were concentrated in key ministries, and the governance provisions around them were described as inconsistent and fragmented.

item.title: Anwar Denied Snap Polls in December — Now His Government Is Quietly Preparing for Elections in 2026
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister / Unity Government sources

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-06

📌 What Happened

In December 2025, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim told journalists that snap elections were not on the cards — his priority, he said, was implementing reforms and addressing cost of living. Fast forward to March 2026: multiple government insiders, party grassroots leaders, and civil servants have told CNA that preparations are quietly underway for a possible general election in the second half of 2026. A Johor politician from the unity government said grassroots have been told to ramp up preparations after Hari Raya Aidilfitri. A senior civil servant confirmed government administrative officers have been placed on alert and resources put “on standby” from June. EC deputy chairman Azmi Sharom said the commission is ready, including for concurrent state and parliamentary polls.

item.title: Anwar Tells Bersih to Stop Criticising MACC 'During Ramadan' — Uses the Holy Month as a Shield Against Accountability
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-06

📌 What Happened

On March 6, 2026, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim publicly dismissed the Coalition for Clean and Fair Elections (Bersih)’s accusation that the Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC) has become a political tool of the government. Speaking after the Public Service Department’s Ihya’ Ramadan programme in Putrajaya, Anwar called Bersih’s statement “unfair” and said the group was “not making clean statements.” He then added: “Do not attack people without first obtaining information, especially during Ramadan.” He pointed to the government’s investigative committee and the Attorney General as reasons to defer criticism, saying no reports had been received yet.

item.title: [BM] Loke Akui DAP Gagal Dapat Persetujuan Kabinet Untuk Siasatan Diraja SPRM — Parti Reformasi Tak Mampu Reformasi Kerajaannya Sendiri
item.description:
Said by: Anthony Loke, Transport Minister and DAP Secretary-General

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-05

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 5 Mac 2026, Jawatankuasa Kerja Pusat DAP mengulangi seruannya untuk Suruhanjaya Siasatan Diraja terhadap dakwaan bahawa Suruhanjaya Pencegahan Rasuah Malaysia beroperasi sebagai “mafia korporat” di bawah ketua Azam Baki. Setiausaha Agung DAP dan Menteri Pengangkutan Anthony Loke pertama kali mencadangkan RCI kepada Kabinet pada akhir Februari, memanggil tindak balas kerajaan terhadap laporan penyiasatan Bloomberg 11 Februari “tidak memadai.” Tetapi walaupun seruan awam berulang dan sokongan CEC, Loke seterusnya mengakui bahawa DAP tidak mampu memujuk Kabinet untuk menubuhkan RCI. Setiausaha politik Anwar Kamil Azmil Munawar menolak cadangan itu, menyatakan sebarang tindakan “mesti bersandarkan fakta yang mantap dan bukti yang boleh dipercayai” — seolah-olah Suruhanjaya Diraja itu sendiri bukan badan pencari fakta.

item.title: [BM] Pengerusi DAPSY Amaran SPRM Mewujudkan 'Suasana Ketakutan' — Sayap Belia PH Sendiri Bersuara Menentang Taktik Penguatkuasaan
item.description:
Said by: Woo Kah Leong, DAPSY National Chairman

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-05

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU

Pada 5 Mac 2026, Pengerusi Kebangsaan DAPSY YB Woo Kah Leong mengeluarkan kenyataan akhbar rasmi tujuh perkara mengkritik Suruhanjaya Pencegahan Rasuah Malaysia (SPRM) kerana menjalankan siasatan yang beliau sifatkan tidak setimpal dan menggeruni.

Perkara utama kenyataan tersebut:

  • DAPSY “amat bimbang” tentang cara SPRM menjalankan siasatan berprofil tinggi baru-baru ini
  • Individu yang disiasat “bukan ahli kewangan pelarian seperti Jho Low mahupun ahli perniagaan berkuasa yang dikaitkan dengan tuduhan mafia korporat”
  • Sifat berprofil tinggi siasatan itu “kelihatan tidak setimpal dan tidak perlu”
  • SPRM “tidak boleh terlibat dalam pemburuan ahli sihir politik terhadap rakyat biasa”
  • Jika kuasa penguatkuasaan dilaksanakan secara terpilih, “Kerajaan Perpaduan pasti akan menanggung akibat politiknya”
  • Usaha antirasuah mesti “mengukuhkan demokrasi dan memastikan tadbir urus yang baik, bukannya melemahkannya dengan mewujudkan tanggapan bahawa jentera kerajaan digunakan untuk menekan atau menyenyapkan individu”

🔥 KENAPA INI PENTING

Ini bukan serangan pembangkang. Ini adalah sayap belia DAP sendiri — komponen utama gabungan Pakatan Harapan yang memerintah — secara terbuka menuduh agensi antirasuah kerajaan mewujudkan “suasana ketakutan” dan terlibat dalam “pemburuan ahli sihir politik.”

item.title: [BM] Pengerusi DAPSY Amaran SPRM Wujudkan 'Suasana Ketakutan' — Sayap Belia PH Sendiri Pecah Barisan Soal Taktik Penguatkuasaan

Antara perkara utama kenyataan itu:

  • DAPSY “amat bimbang” tentang cara SPRM menjalankan siasatan berprofil tinggi baru-baru ini
  • Individu yang disiasat “bukan pembiaya pelarian seperti Jho Low mahupun ahli perniagaan berkuasa berkaitan dakwaan mafia korporat”

  • Jika kuasa penguatkuasaan dilaksanakan secara terpilih, “Kerajaan Perpaduan pasti menanggung akibat politik”

🔥 Kenapa Ini Penting

Ini bukan serangan pembangkang. Ini sayap belia DAP sendiri — komponen utama gabungan pemerintah Pakatan Harapan — secara terbuka menuduh agensi antirasuah kerajaan mewujudkan “suasana ketakutan” dan terlibat dalam “pemburuan ahli sihir politik.” Apabila sayap belia rakan gabungan anda sendiri mengeluarkan kenyataan akhbar rasmi memberi amaran bahawa SPRM mensasarkan individu secara terpilih, anda mempunyai krisis tadbir urus.

item.title: DAP Reviews Coalition Ties Over MACC Scandal — Unity Government Cracking
item.description:
Said by: DAP / Reuters

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-05

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 5 March 2026, DAP — the largest non-Malay party in Anwar’s ruling coalition — publicly announced it was “reviewing its role” in the Unity Government amid deepening rifts over the MACC scandal. DAP called for an independent inquiry into MACC’s alleged “corporate mafia” operations, saying the government’s task force “does not go far enough.” The announcement came after weeks of Bloomberg exposés about MACC chief Azam Baki’s shareholdings and alleged misconduct.

item.title: DAPSY Chairman Warns MACC Creating 'Climate of Fear' — PH's Own Youth Wing Breaks Ranks on Enforcement Tactics
item.description:
Said by: Woo Kah Leong, DAPSY National Chairman

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-05

📌 WHAT HAPPENED

On 5 March 2026, DAPSY National Chairman YB Woo Kah Leong issued a formal seven-point press statement criticising the Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC) for conducting what he called disproportionate and intimidating investigations.

The key points of the statement:

  • DAPSY is “deeply concerned” about how MACC has conducted recent high-profile investigations
  • The individual being investigated is “neither a fugitive financier like Jho Low nor a powerful businessman linked to corporate mafia allegations”
  • The high-profile nature of the investigation “appears disproportionate and unnecessary”
  • MACC “must not engage in political witch-hunting against an ordinary citizen”
  • If enforcement powers are exercised selectively, “the Unity Government will inevitably bear the political consequences”
  • Anti-corruption efforts must “strengthen democracy and ensure good governance, instead of weakening it by creating the perception that government machinery is used to pressure or silence individuals” The statement is widely understood to refer to MACC’s search for a former aide to ex-Economy Minister Rafizi Ramli, identified in various reports as Chai. The MACC had launched a high-profile search operation that drew public attention and criticism.

🔥 WHY IT MATTERS

This is not an opposition attack. This is DAP’s own youth wing — a key component of the ruling Pakatan Harapan coalition — publicly accusing the government’s anti-corruption agency of creating a “climate of fear” and engaging in “political witch-hunting.”

item.title: Fahmi Blames 'Opposition Confusion' for PM Tenure Bill Failure — When 8 of His OWN MPs Didn't Show Up
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-05

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On March 5, 2026, Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil told reporters in Putrajaya that the constitutional amendment bill to limit the PM’s tenure to 10 years failed because opposition MPs were “confused.” He claimed several opposition lawmakers mistakenly believed the bill was designed to give PM Anwar Ibrahim a 10-year term in office, rather than to cap any future PM’s tenure. Fahmi said: “There were MPs from the opposition who gave feedback to one of the ministers saying they thought the vote that day was meant to give Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim a 10-year term as prime minister.” He did not identify which opposition MPs were allegedly confused. PAS secretary-general Takiyuddin Hassan hit back, calling the claim “irresponsible” and “misplaced.”

item.title: Loke Admits DAP Failed to Get Cabinet to Agree on MACC Royal Inquiry — Reform Party Can't Reform Its Own Government
item.description:
Said by: Anthony Loke, Transport Minister and DAP Secretary-General

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-05

📌 What Happened

On March 5, 2026, DAP’s Central Executive Committee reiterated its call for a Royal Commission of Inquiry into allegations that the Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission operated as a “corporate mafia” under chief Azam Baki. DAP Secretary-General and Transport Minister Anthony Loke had first proposed the RCI to Cabinet in late February, calling the government’s response to Bloomberg’s February 11 investigative report “inadequate.” But despite repeated public calls and CEC backing, Loke subsequently admitted that DAP could not persuade Cabinet to establish the RCI. Anwar’s political secretary Kamil Azmil Munawar dismissed the proposal, stating any action “must be grounded in established facts and credible evidence” — as if a Royal Commission was not itself a fact-finding body.

item.title: PKR Accused of Lobbying US Against Najib — The SAME Thing Anwar Calls a 'Plot' When Done to Him
item.description:

Shahidan demanded Anwar explain the double standard: PKR lobbied foreign powers against Najib, but when Daim Zainuddin’s family allegedly engaged international PR firms, Anwar calls it a ‘plot to topple the government’ and launches police investigations.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Dakwa 'Kumpulan Zionis Terkemuka' Dalang Komplot Guling Kerajaan — Disaman Keluarga Daim
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-04

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim memberitahu Parlimen pada 3–4 Mac bahawa dakwaan komplot mengulingkan kerajaannya melibatkan “tokoh terkemuka berkaitan Zionis,” jurubank asing, dan agensi media antarabangsa. Beliau tidak menamakan sesiapa secara langsung tetapi berkata suspek telah melantik firma PR berpangkalan di UK untuk melancarkan “serangan terselaras” terhadap institusi negara sebelum pilihan raya seterusnya. Polis telah mengumumkan siasatan Seksyen 124B pada 27 Februari, difahami secara meluas menyasarkan keluarga bekas menteri kewangan Daim Zainuddin — khususnya balunya Na’imah Abdul Khalid dan anak-anak mereka. Pada 6 Mac, keluarga Daim memfailkan saman di Mahkamah Tinggi Kuala Lumpur terhadap Anwar, Ketua Polis Negara Mohd Khalid Ismail, dan kerajaan, menuntut pengisytiharan bahawa siasatan itu “tidak sah, bertentangan perlembagaan dan dicemari niat jahat.”

item.title: [BM] Fahmi Kata Rang Undang-Undang Pemisahan PG-PP Perlu 3 Bulan Lagi — Reformasi Utama PH Terus Ditangguhkan

Pemisahan PG-PP adalah antara ikrar reformasi Anwar yang paling awal dan paling menonjol.

Category: Politics

Pada 4 Mac 2026, Menteri Besar Negeri Sembilan Datuk Seri Aminuddin Harun secara terbuka mengakui bahawa kereta rasminya secara rutin melanggar lampu merah, selepas video tular menunjukkan sebuah kenderaan yang dipercayai miliknya menggunakan lampu strobo biru dan siren untuk melalui lampu merah di Jalan Rasah. Bercakap kepada wartawan selepas mesyuarat majlis mesyuarat kerajaan negeri, Aminuddin berkata: “Saya akui kami terpaksa melepasi lampu kadangkala, tetapi saya tiada pilihan, kerana kadangkala ada beberapa acara rasmi berturut-turut dalam sehari.” Dia menunjukkan laman Facebooknya sebagai bukti jadualnya yang padat.

item.title: [BM] Timbalan Menteri Beritahu Parlimen Endowmen Hindu Mesti Di Peringkat Negeri — Perlembagaan Kata Sebaliknya
item.description:

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-04

Pada 4 Mac 2026, Timbalan Menteri Perpaduan Negara R Yuneswaran memberitahu Dewan Negara bahawa lembaga endowmen Hindu mesti ditubuhkan di peringkat negeri, mendakwa ini selaras dengan peruntukan perlembagaan di bawah Senarai Negeri Jadual Kesembilan. Beliau menjawab cadangan senator Dr RA Lingeshwaran untuk lembaga endowmen Hindu peringkat kebangsaan bagi mengawal selia isu kuil. Yuneswaran berkata kementerian akan “menyokong sepenuhnya” negeri menubuhkan lembaga mereka sendiri, merujuk model Pulau Pinang. Bekas ahli DUN Pulau Pinang Satees Muniandy dan bekas pengerusi Lembaga Endowmen Hindu Pulau Pinang P Ramasamy segera menegur timbalan menteri itu, menunjuk kepada Perkara 15(c) Senarai Persekutuan, yang secara jelas meletakkan endowmen Hindu di bawah bidang kuasa persekutuan — bukan negeri.

item.title: Anwar Claims 'Prominent Zionist Group' Behind Plot to Topple Government — Gets Sued by Daim's Family for It
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-04

📌 What Happened

Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim told Parliament on March 3–4 that an alleged plot to topple his government involved a “prominent Zionist-linked figure,” foreign bankers, and an international media agency. He named no individual directly but said the suspects had engaged a UK-based PR firm to launch a “coordinated attack” on national institutions before the next election. Police had announced a Section 124B investigation on February 27, widely understood to target the family of late former finance minister Daim Zainuddin — specifically his widow Na’imah Abdul Khalid and their sons. On March 6, the Daim family filed a lawsuit at the Kuala Lumpur High Court against Anwar, Inspector-General of Police Mohd Khalid Ismail, and the government, seeking a declaration that the investigation is “unlawful, unconstitutional and tainted by bad faith.”

item.title: Deputy Minister Tells Parliament Hindu Endowments Must Be at State Level — The Constitution Says Otherwise
item.description:
Said by: R Yuneswaran, Deputy National Unity Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-04

📌 What Happened

On March 4, 2026, Deputy National Unity Minister R Yuneswaran told the Dewan Negara that Hindu endowments boards must be established at the state level, claiming this was in line with constitutional provisions under the State List of the Ninth Schedule. He was responding to a proposal by senator Dr RA Lingeshwaran for a national-level Hindu endowments board to regulate temple issues. Yuneswaran said the ministry would “fully support” states in setting up their own boards, citing Penang’s model. Former Penang assemblyman Satees Muniandy and former Penang Hindu Endowments Board chairman P Ramasamy immediately called out the deputy minister, pointing to Item 15(c) of the Federal List, which explicitly places Hindu endowments under federal — not state — jurisdiction.

item.title: Fahmi Says AG-PP Separation Bill Needs 3 More Months — PH's Flagship Reform Keeps Getting Pushed Back
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-04

📌 What Happened

On March 4, Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil announced that the bill to separate the Attorney General and Public Prosecutor roles requires three more months of refinement before it can be tabled. A select committee chaired by Datuk Seri Azalina Othman Said will convene on March 16 to examine feedback from MPs. This came just one day after the government failed to pass the PM tenure limit bill — another flagship constitutional reform — falling two votes short of the required two-thirds majority. The AG-PP separation was one of Anwar’s earliest and most prominent reform pledges, first announced as part of his institutional reform package.

item.title: Negri Sembilan MB Admits His Driver Runs Red Lights — 'I Have No Choice, Look at My Facebook Schedule'
item.description:
Said by: Aminuddin Harun, Menteri Besar of Negri Sembilan (PH-Lenggeng)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-04

📌 What Happened

On March 4, 2026, Negri Sembilan Menteri Besar Datuk Seri Aminuddin Harun publicly admitted that his official car routinely runs red lights, after a viral video showed a vehicle believed to be his using blue strobe lights and a siren to blast through a red light on Jalan Rasah. Speaking to reporters after a state executive council meeting, Aminuddin said: “I admit that we have to beat the light at times, but I have no choice, as there are sometimes several official events lined up in a day.” He pointed to his Facebook page as proof of his hectic schedule. He added that a police officer is always present in the car, and that his office has sought “necessary approvals from the relevant authorities.”

item.title: [BM] Amirudin Puji Kegagalan RUU Had Penggal PM Sebagai Bukti 'Komitmen Reformasi' Anwar — Kalah Dua Undi Walaupun Pegang Majoriti Besar

item.title: [BM] Anwar Dakwa 'Komplot Zionis' Gulingkan Kerajaan — Keluarga Daim Saman, Panggil Ia 'Salah Guna Kuasa'

item.description:

Dalam kenyataan susulan yang dilaporkan FMT dan Malay Mail, Anwar melangkah lebih jauh — mendakwa konspirasi itu melibatkan “Zionis,” kumpulan pelobi asing, bankir, dan agensi media antarabangsa, semuanya didorong oleh rintangan terhadap usaha anti-rasuah “berskala besar” kerajaannya. Pada 6 Mac, keluarga mendiang bekas Menteri Kewangan Daim Zainuddin — yang isterinya Na’imah Abdul Khalid dikenal pasti secara meluas sebagai sasaran siasatan — memfailkan saman terhadap Anwar, Ketua Polis Negara Mohd Khalid Ismail, dan kerajaan, mendakwa siasatan itu “menyalahi undang-undang” dan “berniat jahat.”

item.title: [BM] Anwar Dakwa 'Kumpulan Zionis Terkemuka' Dalang Komplot Guling Kerajaan — Sementara Ketua Anti-Rasuah Sendiri Hadapi Skandal Saham RM14 Juta
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-03

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 3 Mac 2026, Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim memberitahu parlimen bahawa polis sedang menyiasat dakwaan komplot untuk mengulingkan kerajaannya, yang melibatkan apa yang disifatkannya sebagai “sekumpulan rakyat Malaysia yang memanfaatkan pengaruh media dan institusi antarabangsa, termasuk melibatkan kumpulan Zionis terkemuka.” Beliau mendakwa pihak terbabit telah menggunakan firma PR antarabangsa dan menyasarkan Bloomberg sebagai sebahagian kempen terancang untuk melemahkan institusi negara sebelum PRU16. Katanya, komplot ini dicetuskan oleh “siasatan rasuah berskala besar” oleh SPRM dan bermula sejak Ogos 2024. Dokumen yang dikaitkan dengan firma antarabangsa itu didakwa menggariskan strategi untuk menggerakkan media asing dan memanfaatkan rangkaian luar negara bagi menekan institusi Malaysia.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Dakwa 'Kumpulan Zionis Terkemuka' Dalang Plot Guling Kerajaan — Balu Daim Kata Ia 'Pembohongan Nyata'
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-03

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 3 Mac 2026, Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim memberitahu Parlimen bahawa “kumpulan Zionis terkemuka” terlibat dalam dakwaan plot untuk menggulingkan kerajaannya. Anwar mendakwa dokumen yang diperoleh pihak berkuasa menunjukkan seorang suspek — dikaitkan dengan siasatan rasuah besar-besaran SPRM — telah melantik firma PR berpangkalan di UK untuk menyelaras kempen antarabangsa bagi menjejaskan institusi Malaysia. Beliau menamakan Bloomberg sebagai salah satu agensi media yang disasarkan dan berkata strategi itu, dari Ogos 2024 hingga pilihan raya umum akan datang, melibatkan pelobi asing, jurubank, dan ahli parlimen. Na’imah Abdul Khalid, balu bekas Menteri Kewangan Daim Zainuddin, melalui peguamnya Rajesh Nagarajan dan Sachpreetraj Singh, menyifatkan dakwaan Anwar sebagai “palsu, tidak masuk akal, keterlaluan, dan percubaan terang-terangan untuk mengelirukan Parlimen dan rakyat,” menegaskan “tiada satu perkataan pun tentang Zionisme atau Israel” dalam pelan komunikasi tersebut.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Guna 'Zionis' Dan 'Bankir' Di Parlimen Untuk Burukkan Balu Daim — Peguam Panggil 'Pembohongan Terang-terangan'
item.description:

Beliau mendakwa sebuah firma PR berpusat di UK telah diupah untuk melancarkan serangan terkoordinasi terhadap institusi negara. Ini berlaku sehari selepas MalaysiaNow mendedahkan bahawa pemimpin PKR sendiri pernah mengupah perunding AS pada 2016 untuk membina tekanan Rumah Putih terhadap PM ketika itu Najib Razak. Peguam Na’imah, Rajesh Nagarajan dan Sachpreetraj Singh, mengeluarkan kenyataan pada hari yang sama memanggil dakwaan Anwar “palsu, tidak munasabah, keterlaluan, dan percubaan terang-terangan untuk mengelirukan Parlimen.”

item.title: [BM] Fahmi Salahkan 'Kekeliruan' Pembangkang Atas Kegagalan Rang Undang-Undang Had Penggal PM — Sementara 8 Ahli Parlimen Kerajaan Tak Hadir Pun
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-03

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 2 Mac 2026, Rang Undang-Undang Perlembagaan (Pindaan) 2026 untuk menghadkan penggal Perdana Menteri kepada dua penggal (10 tahun) dibawa ke undian blok di Dewan Rakyat. Ia memerlukan majoriti dua pertiga sebanyak 148 undi. Ia dapat 146. Tiga puluh dua ahli parlimen tidak hadir, termasuk lapan dari blok kerajaan, dan 44 ahli parlimen pembangkang yang hadir memilih berkecuali. Rang undang-undang gagal dengan dua undi. Keesokan harinya, Menteri Komunikasi Fahmi Fadzil menyalahkan pembangkang kerana ‘kekeliruan’ dan berkata ketidakhadiran mereka membuktikan mereka tidak mahu menghadkan kuasa perdana menteri — sambil mengabaikan hakikat bahawa blok kerajaannya sendiri tidak mampu pastikan kehadiran penuh untuk apa yang sepatutnya reformasi utama.

item.title: [BM] Rang Undang-Undang Had Penggal PH Sendiri Gagal 2 Undi — 32 AP Tidak Hadir, 44 Berkecuali, Sifar Menentang
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister / Pakatan Harapan Coalition

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-03

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 3 Mac 2026, parlimen Malaysia mengundi Rang Undang-Undang Perlembagaan (Pindaan) 2026, yang bakal menetapkan had dua penggal, 10 tahun untuk perdana menteri — salah satu janji reformasi utama Anwar Ibrahim sejak memegang jawatan pada November 2022. Rang undang-undang itu memerlukan majoriti dua pertiga sebanyak 148 undi. Ia mendapat 146. Yang Dipertua Dewan Tan Sri Johari Abdul mengumumkan keputusan: 146 menyokong, 32 tidak hadir, 44 berkecuali. Tiada seorang pun AP mengundi menentang rang undang-undang itu. Ia gagal kerana gabungan kerajaan sendiri tidak mampu menghadirkan ahlinya ke dewan.

item.title: [BM] Rang Undang-Undang Had Penggal PH Sendiri Gagal Dua Undi — 32 AP Tidak Hadir, 44 Berkecuali, Sifar Mengundi Menentang
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister / Pakatan Harapan Coalition

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-03

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

item.title: Anwar Claims 'Prominent Zionist Group' Behind Plot to Topple Government — Daim's Widow Calls It an 'Outright Lie'
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-03

📌 What Happened

On March 3, 2026, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim told Parliament that a “prominent Zionist group” was involved in an alleged plot to topple his government. Anwar claimed documents obtained by authorities showed a suspect — linked to a large-scale MACC corruption investigation — had engaged a UK-based PR firm to coordinate an international campaign to undermine Malaysian institutions. He named Bloomberg as one of the media agencies targeted and said the strategy, running from August 2024 to the next general election, involved foreign lobbyists, bankers, and lawmakers. Na’imah Abdul Khalid, the widow of former Finance Minister Daim Zainuddin, through her lawyers Rajesh Nagarajan and Sachpreetraj Singh, called Anwar’s claims “false, preposterous, outrageous, and a blatant attempt to mislead Parliament and the public,” stating there was “not one word about Zionism or Israel” in the communications plan.

He said the plot was triggered by “large-scale corruption investigations” by the MACC and had been running since August 2024. Documents linked to an international firm allegedly outlined strategies to mobilise foreign media and leverage overseas networks to pressure Malaysian institutions.

On March 6, the family of the late former Finance Minister Daim Zainuddin — whose widow Na’imah Abdul Khalid was widely identified as the investigation’s target — filed a lawsuit against Anwar, Inspector-General of Police Mohd Khalid Ismail, and the government, calling the probe “unlawful” and “tainted with bad faith.”

item.title: Fahmi Blames Opposition 'Confusion' for Failed PM Term Limit Bill — While 8 Government MPs Didn't Even Show Up
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-03

📌 What Happened

On March 2, 2026, the Constitutional (Amendment) Bill 2026 to limit the Prime Minister’s tenure to two terms (10 years) was put to a bloc vote in the Dewan Rakyat. It needed a two-thirds supermajority of 148 votes. It got 146. Thirty-two MPs were absent, including eight from the government bloc, and 44 opposition MPs who were present abstained. The bill failed by two votes. The next day, Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil blamed the opposition for “confusion” and said their abstentions proved they didn’t want to limit prime ministerial power — while glossing over the fact that his own government couldn’t even get full attendance for what was supposed to be a flagship reform.

The bill needed a two-thirds supermajority of 148 votes. It got 146. House Speaker Tan Sri Johari Abdul announced the results: 146 in favor, 32 absent, 44 abstained. Not a single MP voted against the bill. It failed because the government’s own coalition could not get its members into the chamber.

Date: 2026-03-02

📌 What Happened

On March 2, 2026, the Dewan Rakyat voted on the Constitution (Amendment) Bill 2026, which would have limited the Prime Minister’s tenure to a maximum of 10 years — two terms. The bill was a flagship reform promise from Pakatan Harapan’s 2022 manifesto, explicitly framed as a safeguard against another Mahathir-style 22-year grip on power. It failed. The bill received 146 votes in favour — two short of the 148 needed for a two-thirds constitutional majority. Dewan Rakyat Speaker Tan Sri Johari Abdul announced that 32 MPs were absent and 44 abstained. Not a single MP voted against it. They simply didn’t bother.

item.title: Anwar's Term Limit Bill Fails By Two Votes Despite Supermajority — Government's Answer? 'We'll Try Again In June'
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister / Azalina Othman Said, Law Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-02

📌 What Happened

On March 2, Malaysia’s Parliament voted down the Constitutional (Amendment) Bill 2026, which would have limited the Prime Minister’s tenure to two terms or 10 years. The bill received 146 votes — just two short of the 148 needed for a two-thirds majority. Anwar’s unity government holds at least 153 seats, meaning the bill should have passed easily. But enough coalition MPs simply did not show up. Law Minister Azalina Othman Said had championed the bill as a way to “bolster institutional integrity.” The following day, the government quietly delayed a vote on the attorney general-public prosecutor separation bill — another flagship reform promise. The government has since pledged to reintroduce the term limit bill in June.

item.title: PH's Own PM Term Limit Bill Fails by Two Votes — 8 Government MPs Didn't Even Show Up
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister / Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister / Anthony Loke, DAP Secretary-General

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-02

📌 What Happened

On March 2, 2026, Malaysia’s Dewan Rakyat voted on the Constitution (Amendment) Bill 2026 — PH’s long-promised reform to limit the prime minister’s tenure to 10 years (two terms). The bill needed 148 votes — a two-thirds supermajority — to pass. It got 146. Two votes short. Speaker Tan Sri Johari Abdul confirmed that 44 MPs abstained (mostly opposition), 32 were absent, and — in a telling detail — not a single MP voted against it. Among the absentees were 8 government-supporting MPs. Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil later confirmed that only 2 of the 8 had submitted formal explanations; 6 had not even bothered. DAP Secretary-General Anthony Loke issued a strongly worded statement emphasising that all 40 DAP MPs were present, and pointedly called out the empty seats.

item.title: PH's Tenure Limit Bill Fails by Two Votes — Their Own Government Couldn't Be Bothered to Show Up
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister / Pakatan Harapan

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-02

📌 What Happened

On March 2, 2026, Malaysia’s Parliament voted on the Constitution (Amendment) Bill 2026, which sought to amend Article 43 to limit any prime minister’s tenure to a cumulative maximum of 10 years — a flagship reform promise from Anwar Ibrahim’s Pakatan Harapan since GE15. The bill needed a two-thirds supermajority of 148 votes. It received 146. Forty-four MPs abstained, 32 were absent, and zero voted against. The government bloc holds at least 153 seats — comfortably more than enough. Among the absent government-side MPs were BN’s Hishammuddin Hussein, Suhaimi Nasir, and Saravanan Murugan; GPS’s Henry Sum Agong; GRS’s Jeffery Kitingan; and PBM’s Larry Sng. PH’s Deputy Speaker Alice Lau was quick to note that all PH MPs attended — a defence that tells you everything about how PH processes failure.

Bloomberg seterusnya mendakwa pegawai SPRM telah berpakat dengan ahli perniagaan untuk merancang pengambilalihan bermusuhan firma tersenarai, menggunakan serbuan dan ugutan untuk memaksa eksekutif menjual saham kepada kumpulan yang digelar “mafia korporat.” Respons Anwar ialah pasukan petugas — bukan siasatan bebas, bukan Suruhanjaya Diraja. item.title: Azam Baki's RM100M Defamation Suit Against Bloomberg — MACC Chief Fights Media Instead of Corruption

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-02-27

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 27 February 2026, it was reported that MACC Chief Commissioner Azam Baki filed a RM100 million defamation suit against Bloomberg. The suit came after Bloomberg published an investigation alleging that Azam owned millions of shares in publicly listed companies — potentially breaching civil servant ownership limits. Bloomberg further alleged that MACC officials had colluded with businessmen to orchestrate hostile takeovers of listed firms, using raids and intimidation to force executives into selling shares to groups dubbed the “corporate mafia.” Rather than resigning or submitting to an independent investigation, Azam chose to sue the messenger. Anwar’s response was to announce a task force — not an independent inquiry, not a Royal Commission. Even DAP, his own coalition partner, said a task force “does not go far enough.”

Anwar was responding to an opposition MP who asked if ministers would be forced to resign for poor performance. His reply: “Accountability is not only about punishment but also correction, continuous improvement, and the moral responsibility ministers held for the people.” No KPIs have ever been publicly disclosed for any minister in Anwar’s cabinet. No minister has been penalised, demoted, or publicly reprimanded for underperformance. Two ministers were removed in the December 2025 reshuffle — including Rafizi Ramli — but Anwar framed it as “portfolio realignment,” not performance accountability.

item.title: Anwar Appoints Controversial Ex-AG to Judicial Appointments Commission — Malaysian Bar Sues to Quash It
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister / Ahmad Terrirudin Mohd Salleh, Federal Court Judge

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-02-16

📌 What Happened

On February 16, 2026, the Malaysian Bar — representing 24,000 lawyers — filed a judicial review application at the High Court to quash Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s appointment of Federal Court judge Ahmad Terrirudin Mohd Salleh to the Judicial Appointments Commission (JAC). Terrirudin, Anwar’s former Attorney General, was appointed to the JAC on November 15, 2025 despite being the most junior judge on the Federal Court bench — breaking long-standing convention that the position goes to a senior apex court judge. The Bar named Anwar, Terrirudin, the JAC, and the government as respondents.
