📌 APA YANG BERLAKU

Pada 12 Februari 2026, Menteri Pelancongan Tiong King Sing melancarkan kempen ‘Mesra Malaysia’ di KL Sentral — kempen tentang bersikap mesra dan bertimbang rasa kepada pelancong. Semasa pelancaran, Tiong mengadu tentang sikap biadap daripada kakitangan sektor awam dan swasta, berkata: “Sesetengah pegawai rasa mereka mempunyai banyak kuasa. Tetapi apabila orang tidak faham sesuatu isu, kita mesti jelaskan.”

item.title: Anwar Defends MACC Chief Azam Baki Over Second Shareholding Scandal, Tells Critics to 'Read His Explanation'
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-02-12

📌 WHAT HAPPENED

In February 2026, Bloomberg reported that MACC chief Azam Baki was a key shareholder in a financial services company — Velocity Capital Partners Berhad — based on corporate filings. This was Azam’s second shareholding scandal, following the 2022 controversy over shares in Excel Force MSC Berhad.

Civil society groups including C4 Center demanded Azam’s immediate suspension pending investigation. They noted concerning links between Velocity Capital Partners and MMAG Holdings, where controversial former Anwar aide Farhash Wafa Salvador had acquired a 20% stake and was appointed chairman.

item.title: Tiong King Sing Pulls 'Do You Know Who I Am?' Card While Lecturing Staff About Rudeness
item.description:
Said by: Tiong King Sing, Tourism, Arts and Culture Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-02-12

📌 WHAT HAPPENED

On 12 February 2026, Tourism Minister Tiong King Sing launched the ‘Mesra Malaysia’ (Friendly Malaysia) campaign at KL Sentral — a campaign about being welcoming and courteous to tourists. During the launch, Tiong complained about rudeness from public and private sector employees, saying: “Some officers think they have a lot of power. But when people don’t understand certain issues, we must explain.”

item.title: [BM] SPRM Siasat Pegawai Kanan Negeri Pulau Pinang Soal Urus Niaga Tanah — Chow Kata 'Kami Bukan Penyiasat'
item.description:
Said by: Chow Kon Yeow, Penang Chief Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-31

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 31 Januari 2026, KM Pulau Pinang Chow Kon Yeow mengesahkan SPRM sedang menyiasat dakwaan salah guna kuasa melibatkan pegawai kanan negeri mengenai urus niaga tanah. Chow berkata kerajaan negeri akan ‘memberikan ruang penuh’ kepada SPRM dan tidak akan menjalankan siasatan dalaman sendiri. ‘Kami bukan penyiasat, tetapi kami akan memberikan kerjasama penuh,’ beliau memberitahu wartawan. Pegawai tersebut dilaporkan terus menjalankan tugas seperti biasa semasa siasatan.

item.title: MACC Probes Senior Penang State Official Over Land Deal — Chow Says 'We Are Not Investigators'
item.description:
Said by: Chow Kon Yeow, Penang Chief Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-31

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 31 January 2026, Penang CM Chow Kon Yeow confirmed that MACC was investigating allegations of abuse of power involving a senior state official over a land deal. Chow said the state government would ‘give full space’ to MACC and would not conduct its own internal probe. ‘We are not investigators, but we will provide full cooperation,’ he told reporters. The official was reportedly continuing to perform duties as usual during the investigation.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Menyeru 'Kesabaran dan Kebijaksanaan' Selepas Setiap Krisis — Tetapi Tidak Pernah Akauntabiliti
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-15

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Merentas setiap krisis besar dari 2024 hingga 2026, respons Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim mengikut templat yang sama: akui isu, seru “kesabaran dan kebijaksanaan,” ketepikan pengkritik, dan teruskan tanpa perubahan struktur. Apabila 47 pertuduhan Zahid digugurkan: “Saya tidak campur tangan dalam keputusan PG.” Apabila Shamsul Iskandar ditangkap mengeluarkan surat sokongan: “Surat itu kabur” — teguran sahaja. Apabila tawaran tahanan rumah Najib dibangkitkan: “Bertindak balas dengan kesabaran dan kebijaksanaan.” Apabila Bersih mengkritik SPRM: “Tidak adil” — suruh mereka tunggu. Apabila harga diesel naik: “Kita akan dikritik dengan fitnah dan pembohongan.” Apabila kedai KK Mart dibom api: “Jangan jadi pendakwa atau hakim.” Apabila PH dihapuskan di Sabah: “Kekalahan tidak akan hentikan pelaksanaan.” Apabila Rafizi menuduhnya serangan media sosial: memanggilnya “gangguan.”

item.title: Anwar Calls for 'Patience and Wisdom' After Every Crisis — But Never Accountability
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-15

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Across every major crisis from 2024 to 2026, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s response has followed the same template: acknowledge the issue, call for “patience and wisdom,” dismiss critics, and move on without structural change. When Zahid’s 47 charges were dropped: “I don’t interfere in AG decisions.” When Shamsul Iskandar was caught issuing support letters: “The letters were vague” — reprimand only. When Najib’s house arrest bid was raised: “Respond with patience and wisdom.” When Bersih criticised MACC: “Unfair” — told them to wait. When diesel prices hiked: “We will be criticised with slander and lies.” When KK Mart stores were firebombed: “Don’t be prosecutor or judge.” When PH was wiped out in Sabah: “Defeat won’t stop delivery.” When Rafizi accused him of social media attacks: called it a “distraction.”

item.title: [BM] Solidariti Palestin Tetapi Senyap Mengenai Uyghur — Piawai Berganda Terdedah
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim Administration / Critics

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-13

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Sepanjang 2025 dan memasuki 2026, Malaysia di bawah Anwar Ibrahim mengekalkan salah satu pendirian paling lantang di dunia mengenai hak rakyat Palestin — memutuskan hubungan diplomatik dengan Israel, memboikot syarikat berkaitan Israel, dan menceramahi pemimpin dunia tentang “kemunafikan moral.” Walau bagaimanapun, pengkritik menunjukkan piawai berganda yang ketara: kesunyian Malaysia terhadap penganiayaan China ke atas Muslim Uyghur di Xinjiang, tindakan keras brutal Iran terhadap perbezaan pendapat dalaman, krisis kemanusiaan Yaman, dan genosid Myanmar terhadap Muslim Rohingya. Perbincangan Reddit dalam kalangan rakyat Malaysia menuduh kerajaan “aktivisme terpilih.” The Hindu melaporkan Malaysia “mengecam piawai berganda mengenai kekejaman Gaza” — sambil mengamalkan piawai bergandanya sendiri terhadap krisis majoriti Muslim yang lain.

item.title: Palestine Solidarity But Silence on Uyghurs — Double Standards Exposed
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim Administration / Critics

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-13

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Throughout 2025 and into 2026, Malaysia under Anwar Ibrahim maintained one of the most vocal stances globally on Palestinian rights — cutting diplomatic ties with Israel, boycotting Israeli-linked companies, and lecturing world leaders about “moral hypocrisy.” However, critics pointed out a glaring double standard: Malaysia’s silence on China’s persecution of Uyghur Muslims in Xinjiang, Iran’s brutal crackdown on internal dissent, the Yemen humanitarian crisis, and Myanmar’s genocide against Rohingya Muslims. Reddit discussions among Malaysians accused the government of “selective activism.” The Hindu reported Malaysia “slams double standards on Gaza atrocities” — while practising its own double standards on other Muslim-majority crises.

item.title: [BM] Adakah 2026 Tahun PH Tunaikan Janji Pembaharuan? — FMT Bertanya, Sekali Lagi
item.description:
Said by: FMT editorial

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-10

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 10 Januari 2026, FMT menerbitkan artikel pendapat bertajuk “Adakah 2026 tahun PH menunaikan janji pembaharuan?” — soalan yang sama ditanya pada Januari 2024 dan Januari 2025. Pada 5 Januari, Anwar memberikan ucapan Tahun Baru menjanjikan bahawa janji pembaharuan akan “terlaksana tahun ini,” mengumumkan rang undang-undang pemisahan PG-PP akan menjadi “rang undang-undang pertama dibentangkan.” Rang undang-undang itu memang dibentangkan — kemudian serta-merta dirujuk kepada jawatankuasa parlimen untuk tiga bulan lagi “semakan.” Janji ini telah tertangguh sejak PRU14 pada 2018, kini lapan tahun tidak ditunaikan. Kad laporan pembaharuan selepas tiga tahun penuh: pemisahan PG-PP dihantar ke jawatankuasa, AUKU “tiada rancangan” untuk dimansuhkan, Akta Hasutan digunakan 90+ kali dan bukannya dimansuhkan, ICCPR tidak disahkan, pemansuhan tol digantikan dengan pembekuan RM591J, rang undang-undang had penggal PM gagal dengan 2 undi, IPCMC tidak ditubuhkan, Akta Kebebasan Maklumat tidak dibentangkan, pilihan raya kerajaan tempatan tidak dipulihkan.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Ceramah Dunia Tentang Kemunafikan Gaza — Sambil Mengamalkan Kemunafikan Terhadap Setiap Janji Pembaharuan di Tanah Air
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim / NST Report Jan 2026

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-10

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada Januari 2026, Anwar Ibrahim menjadi tajuk berita antarabangsa menceramahi pemimpin dunia tentang “kemunafikan moral” mengenai Gaza, berkata “kepimpinan global gagal Gaza di tengah kemunafikan moral.” Beliau telah meletakkan dirinya sebagai suara utama untuk hak rakyat Palestin di pentas dunia, menghadiri sidang kemuncak, mengeluarkan kecaman, dan memutuskan hubungan diplomatik dengan Israel. CSIS menerbitkan analisis bertajuk “Kematian Reformasi” yang meneliti bagaimana postur antarabangsa Anwar berbeza dengan rekod domestiknya.

item.title: Anwar Lectures World on Gaza Hypocrisy — While Practising Hypocrisy on Every Reform Promise at Home
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim / NST Report Jan 2026

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-10

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In January 2026, Anwar Ibrahim made international headlines lecturing global leaders about “moral hypocrisy” on Gaza, saying “global leadership is failing Gaza amid moral hypocrisy.” He has positioned himself as a leading voice for Palestinian rights on the world stage, attending summits, issuing condemnations, and cutting diplomatic ties with Israel. CSIS published an analysis titled “Death of Reformasi” examining how Anwar’s international posturing contrasts with his domestic record.

item.title: Will 2026 Be the Year PH Fulfils Its Reform Promises? — FMT Asks, Again
item.description:
Said by: FMT editorial

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-10

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 10 January 2026, FMT published an opinion piece titled “Will 2026 be the year PH fulfils its reform promises?” — the same question asked in January 2024 and January 2025. On 5 January, Anwar gave a New Year address promising that reform pledges would “materialise this year,” announcing the AG-PP separation bill would be “the first bill to be tabled.” The bill was indeed tabled — then immediately referred to a parliamentary committee for three more months of “review.” This promise has been pending since GE14 in 2018, now eight years unfulfilled. The reform scorecard after three full years: AG-PP separation sent to committee, UUCA “no plans” to abolish, Sedition Act used 90+ times instead of repealed, ICCPR unratified, toll abolition replaced by RM591M freezes, PM term limit bill failed by 2 votes, IPCMC not established, Freedom of Information Act not tabled, local government elections not restored.

item.title: [BM] 47 Pertuduhan Rasuah Zahid Hamidi NFA — 'Bukti Tidak Mencukupi' Selepas 7 Tahun
item.description:
Said by: Attorney-General’s Chambers

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-08

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 8 Januari 2026, Jabatan Peguam Negara (AGC) menamatkan semua 47 pertuduhan jenayah terhadap Timbalan Perdana Menteri Ahmad Zahid Hamidi, memetik “bukti tidak mencukupi.” Pertuduhan — difailkan pada 2018 selepas UMNO kehilangan kuasa — melibatkan RM31 juta daripada Yayasan Akalbudi, yayasan kebajikan yang dikawal Zahid. Pertuduhan termasuk pecah amanah jenayah, rasuah, dan pengubahan wang haram. Reuters melaporkan AGC mengeluarkan pelepasan tidak berjumlah pembebasan (DNAA) untuk sesetengah pertuduhan dan pembebasan penuh untuk yang lain. Majlis Peguam Malaysia membantah. CSIS menerbitkan analisis bertajuk “Kematian Reformasi.” The Diplomat memanggilnya penggugurkan pertuduhan terhadap “sekutu utama Anwar.”

item.title: Zahid Hamidi's 47 Corruption Charges NFA'd — 'Insufficient Evidence' After 7 Years
item.description:
Said by: Attorney-General’s Chambers

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-08

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 8 January 2026, the Attorney-General’s Chambers (AGC) ended all 47 criminal charges against Deputy Prime Minister Ahmad Zahid Hamidi, citing “insufficient evidence.” The charges — filed in 2018 after UMNO lost power — involved RM31 million from Yayasan Akalbudi, a charitable foundation Zahid controlled. The charges included criminal breach of trust, corruption, and money laundering. Reuters reported the AGC issued a discharge not amounting to an acquittal (DNAA) for some charges and a full acquittal for others. The Malaysian Bar objected. CSIS published an analysis titled “Death of Reformasi.” The Diplomat called it the dropping of charges against “a key Anwar ally.”

item.title: [BM] Cengkaman UMNO Ke Atas PH — Zahid Bebas Sambil Menentukan Dasar Gabungan
item.description:
Said by: Political Analysts / Opposition

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Dinamik paling merosakkan dalam politik Malaysia hari ini ialah pengaruh UMNO yang tidak seimbang ke atas PH dalam gabungan kerajaan perpaduan. TPM Ahmad Zahid Hamidi — yang 47 pertuduhan rasuahnya digugurkan dalam keputusan NFA yang mengejutkan komuniti undang-undang — kini secara efektif memegang kuasa veto ke atas dasar kerajaan. Sokongan UMNO penting untuk majoriti parlimen PH, dan UMNO tahu itu. Hasilnya: Zahid bebas, Najib mendapat pengurangan hukuman dan tawaran tahanan rumah, pemisahan PG-PP terbantut, DAP dipinggirkan dalam rombakan kabinet, dan agenda anti-rasuah secara fungsinya mati. UCA News menggambarkan gabungan perpaduan sebagai mempunyai “mandat yang retak.” CNA melaporkan Anwar menghadapi “krisis rasuah” dengan “perpecahan parti PKR” dan “kegelisahan gabungan PH.”

item.title: [BM] Langkah Khas Anwar: Whataboutisme — 'Tetapi BN Juga Buat' Bukan Agenda Pembaharuan
item.description:
Said by: Parliamentary Hansard / Media Analysis

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Corak retorik yang jelas telah muncul dalam respons parlimen dan awam Anwar Ibrahim terhadap kritikan: alihkan kepada apa yang kerajaan terdahulu atau pembangkang lakukan. Apabila dicabar mengenai surat sokongan untuk tender kerajaan, beliau menunjuk Kelantan. Apabila dicabar mengenai lobi, beliau membawa PKR dahulu. Apabila dicabar mengenai kegagalan pembaharuan, beliau memanggil “keadaan kucar-kacir yang kami warisi.” Ini adalah whataboutisme sistematik yang digunakan sebagai strategi pentadbiran. The Star melaporkan Anwar “menegur kemunafikan pembangkang mengenai surat sokongan” — menukarkan soalan tentang kelakuan kerajaannya sendiri menjadi serangan terhadap pembangkang. CSIS, dalam analisis “Kematian Reformasi"nya, menyatakan bagaimana Anwar secara konsisten mengalih akauntabiliti dengan membingkai semula kritikan sebagai niat jahat pembangkang.

item.title: [BM] Tiada Kerangka Akauntabiliti PRU16 — PH Tiada Sistem untuk Pengundi Jejak Kemajuan Manifesto
item.description:
Said by: Governance Reform Advocates

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Tidak seperti beberapa negara demokrasi di mana kemajuan manifesto kerajaan dijejak secara terbuka, PH tidak mewujudkan sistem rasmi untuk pengundi memantau penyampaian terhadap kira-kira 60 janji yang dibuat dalam PRU15. Tiada papan pemuka awam, tiada laporan kemajuan manifesto tahunan, dan tiada mekanisme berstruktur untuk masyarakat sivil mempertanggungjawabkan kerajaan terhadap komitmen khususnya. Malaysiakini mewujudkan penjejak manifesto bebas kerana kerajaan tidak mahu. The Straits Times menjejak kemajuan PH 1.0 dan mendapati kebanyakan janji “masih jauh dari tercapai” selepas hanya satu tahun.

item.title: Anwar's Signature Move: Whataboutism — 'But BN Did It Too' Is Not a Reform Agenda
item.description:
Said by: Parliamentary Hansard / Media Analysis

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: A clear rhetorical pattern has emerged in Anwar Ibrahim’s parliamentary and public responses to criticism: deflect to what previous governments or the opposition did. When challenged on support letters for government tenders, he pointed to Kelantan. When challenged on lobbying, he brought up PKR’s past. When challenged on reform failures, he invokes the “mess we inherited.” This is systematic whataboutism deployed as governance strategy. The Star reported Anwar “calls out opposition’s hypocrisy over support letters” — turning a question about his own government’s conduct into an attack on the opposition. CSIS, in its “Death of Reformasi” analysis, noted how Anwar consistently deflects accountability by reframing criticism as opposition bad faith.

item.title: No GE16 Accountability Framework — PH Has No System for Voters to Track Manifesto Progress
item.description:
Said by: Governance Reform Advocates

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Unlike some democracies where government manifesto progress is publicly tracked, PH has established no formal system for voters to monitor delivery against the approximately 60 promises made in GE15. There is no public dashboard, no annual manifesto progress report, and no structured mechanism for civil society to hold the government accountable to its specific commitments. Malaysiakini created an independent manifesto tracker because the government wouldn’t. The Straits Times tracked PH 1.0’s progress and found most promises “still had some way to go” after just one year.

item.title: UMNO's Stranglehold on PH — Zahid Walks Free While Dictating Coalition Policy
item.description:
Said by: Political Analysts / Opposition

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-01-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: The single most corrosive dynamic in Malaysian politics today is UMNO’s outsized leverage over PH within the unity government coalition. DPM Ahmad Zahid Hamidi — who had 47 corruption charges dropped in an NFA decision that shocked the legal community — now effectively holds veto power over government policy. UMNO’s support is essential for PH’s parliamentary majority, and UMNO knows it. The result: Zahid walks free, Najib gets sentence reductions and house arrest bids, the AG-PP separation is stalled, DAP is sidelined in the cabinet reshuffle, and the anti-corruption agenda is functionally dead. UCA News described the unity coalition as having a “fractured mandate.” CNA reported Anwar faces a “graft crisis” with “PKR party fractures” and “PH coalition jitters.”

item.title: [BM] Tawaran Tahanan Rumah Najib Ditolak — Mahkamah Putuskan Adendum Diraja Tidak Sah
item.description:
Said by: High Court Judge Alice Loke / Najib Razak

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-22

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 22 Disember 2025, Mahkamah Tinggi KL memutuskan bahawa adendum diraja yang membenarkan bekas PM Najib Razak yang disabitkan kesalahan menjalani baki hukuman 1MDB di bawah tahanan rumah adalah tidak sah. Hakim Alice Loke berkata budi bicara Yang di-Pertuan Agong mesti dilaksanakan “demi kepentingan awam” dan mendapati adendum itu tidak mempunyai asas undang-undang yang kukuh. Al Jazeera dan Reuters kedua-duanya melaporkan keputusan tersebut. Sultan Selangor sebelum ini memberi amaran bahawa pengampunan tidak boleh “sewenang-wenangnya untuk pihak tertentu.” Kerajaan Anwar sudah pun memotong separuh hukuman Najib melalui Lembaga Pengampunan pada Februari 2024 — tawaran tahanan rumah adalah langkah seterusnya dalam corak kelonggaran yang semakin meningkat bagi seorang kleptokrat yang disabitkan kesalahan yang kini partinya menjadi sandaran Anwar.

item.title: Najib House Arrest Bid Rejected — Court Rules Royal Addendum Invalid
item.description:
Said by: High Court Judge Alice Loke / Najib Razak

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-22

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 22 December 2025, the KL High Court ruled that the royal addendum allowing convicted former PM Najib Razak to serve his remaining 1MDB sentence under house arrest was invalid. Judge Alice Loke said the King’s discretion must be exercised “for the public good” and found the addendum lacked proper legal basis. Al Jazeera and Reuters both reported the ruling. The Selangor Sultan had earlier warned that pardons should not be “arbitrary for certain parties.” Anwar’s government had already halved Najib’s sentence via the Pardons Board in February 2024 — the house arrest bid was the next step in an escalating pattern of leniency for a convicted kleptocrat whose party Anwar now depends on.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Kata 'Masih Jauh' Soal Pilihan Raya Pada Disember 2025 — Kini Sedia PRU16 Kilat Untuk 2026
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-17

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU

Pada 17 Disember 2025, Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim memberitahu editor dan wartawan kanan di taklimat di Seri Perdana bahawa beliau menolak sebarang kemungkinan pilihan raya umum kilat pada 2026. “Pilihan raya masih jauh lagi. Saya tidak terfikir tentangnya,” katanya. “Saya menumpukan pada bagaimana kita terus melaksanakan pembaharuan dan meringankan masalah rakyat mengenai kos sara hidup yang lebih tinggi.”

item.title: [BM] Pelantikan Hannah Yeoh Cetuskan Tentangan Berasaskan Kaum — PAS Dan UMNO Sama-Sama Bangkang
item.description:
Said by: Takiyuddin Hassan, PAS Secretary-General

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-17

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada Disember 2025, Anwar melantik Hannah Yeoh sebagai Menteri Wilayah Persekutuan dalam rombakan kabinetnya. Setiausaha Agung PAS Takiyuddin Hassan segera membantah — bukan terhadap kelayakan Yeoh, tetapi terhadap bangsanya. Beliau berhujah pelantikan itu akan “mengukuhkan pengaruh DAP” di kawasan bandar dan merugikan Melayu. Kumpulan Melayu sayap kanan memberi amaran bahawa DAP kini “menguasai tanah pegangan Melayu” melalui portfolio Wilayah Persekutuan, yang menyelia KL, Putrajaya, dan Labuan. Malah pemimpin UMNO secara senyap menyuarakan kebimbangan. Anwar membalas: “Menolak seseorang kerana warna kulit dan bangsanya, ini memalukan pada zaman ini.” Reaksi media sosial terpolarisasi.

item.title: Anwar Says 'Long Way to Go' on Elections in December 2025 — Now Preparing Snap GE16 for 2026
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-17

📌 WHAT HAPPENED

On December 17, 2025, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim told editors and senior journalists at a briefing in Seri Perdana that he had ruled out any possibility of snap general elections in 2026. “The election still has a long way to go. I have not thought about it,” he said. “I am focusing on how we continue to implement reforms and alleviate the problems people face regarding the higher cost of living.”

item.title: Hannah Yeoh Appointment Sparks Race-Based Backlash — PAS and UMNO Both Object
item.description:
Said by: Takiyuddin Hassan, PAS Secretary-General

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-17

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In December 2025, Anwar appointed Hannah Yeoh as Federal Territories Minister in his cabinet reshuffle. PAS Secretary-General Takiyuddin Hassan immediately objected — not to Yeoh’s qualifications, but to her race. He argued the appointment would “strengthen DAP’s influence” in urban areas and disadvantage Malays. Rightist Malay groups warned that DAP was now “controlling Malay landholding” through the Federal Territories portfolio, which oversees KL, Putrajaya, and Labuan. Even UMNO leaders quietly raised concerns. Anwar hit back: “To reject a person because of her colour and race, this is atrocious in this day and age.” Social media reactions were polarised.

item.title: [BM] Rombakan Kabinet Anwar Cetuskan Kontroversi Kaum — Hannah Yeoh Menteri WP, Adam Adli Timbalan Hal Ehwal Agama
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-16

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU

Pada 16 Disember 2025, Anwar Ibrahim mengumumkan rombakan kabinet keduanya, melibatkan 28 perubahan menteri dan timbalan menteri. Antara pelantikan paling kontroversi:

Hannah Yeoh dinamakan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Wilayah Persekutuan) — bukan Melayu pertama memegang portfolio tersebut. PAS dan kumpulan Melayu sayap kanan segera menyerang pelantikan itu, mendakwa ia akan mengukuhkan “dominasi DAP” di KL.

item.title: [BM] Zafrul Dilantik Pengerusi MIDA Selepas Tinggalkan MITI — Pintu Pusingan Tak Pernah Berhenti Berputar
item.description:
Said by: Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz, MIDA Chairman

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-16

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Apabila rombakan kabinet Disember 2025 mengeluarkan Tengku Zafrul daripada portfolio MITI, beliau tidak dihantar ke bangku belakang. Sebaliknya, Anwar melantiknya sebagai Pengerusi MIDA (Lembaga Pembangunan Pelaburan Malaysia) — agensi yang berada di bawah bidang kuasa MITI — dan sebagai Penasihat Politik Kanan kepada PM. Orang yang menyelia MIDA sebagai menteri kini mengetuainya sebagai pelantikan politik.

item.title: Anwar's Cabinet Reshuffle Sparks Race Controversy — Hannah Yeoh as FT Minister, Adam Adli as Religious Affairs Deputy
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-16

📌 WHAT HAPPENED

On December 16, 2025, Anwar Ibrahim announced his second cabinet reshuffle, involving 28 ministerial and deputy ministerial changes. Among the most controversial appointments:

Hannah Yeoh was named Minister in the Prime Minister’s Department (Federal Territories) — the first non-Malay to hold the portfolio. PAS and right-wing Malay groups immediately attacked the appointment, claiming it would strengthen “DAP dominance” in KL and threaten Malay interests. Anwar called the criticism “atrocious” and said race should not determine ministerial capability.

item.title: Zafrul Appointed MIDA Chairman After Leaving MITI — The Revolving Door Never Stops Spinning
item.description:
Said by: Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz, MIDA Chairman

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-16

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: When the December 2025 cabinet reshuffle removed Tengku Zafrul from the MITI portfolio, he wasn’t sent to the backbench. Instead, Anwar appointed him as Chairman of MIDA (Malaysian Investment Development Authority) — the very agency that falls under MITI’s purview — and as Senior Political Advisor to the PM. The man who oversaw MIDA as minister now chairs it as a political appointee.

item.title: [BM] Perkhidmatan Awam 90% Bumiputera — Melayu Pegang 80%+ Jawatan Tertinggi
item.description:
Said by: Eurasia Review Analysis

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-15

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Menurut analisis Eurasia Review yang diterbitkan pada Disember 2025, perkhidmatan awam Malaysia yang berjumlah 1.3 hingga 1.6 juta pekerja adalah kira-kira 90% Bumiputera. Melayu memegang 77.5% daripada semua jawatan dan lebih 80% jawatan pengurusan tertinggi. Malaysia Cina hanya memegang 5.7% dan Malaysia India 3.8% — di sebuah negara di mana Cina membentuk 23% dan India 7% daripada populasi. Straits Times melaporkan “perdebatan dasar Bumiputera-dahulu” telah mengambil “campuran kuat kesihatan, pendidikan dan politik.”

item.title: Civil Service is 90% Bumiputera — Malays Hold 80%+ of Top Posts
item.description:
Said by: Eurasia Review Analysis

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-15

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: According to Eurasia Review analysis published in December 2025, Malaysia’s civil service of 1.3 to 1.6 million employees is approximately 90% Bumiputera. Malays hold 77.5% of all posts and over 80% of top management positions. Chinese Malaysians hold just 5.7% and Indian Malaysians 3.8% — in a country where Chinese make up 23% and Indians 7% of the population. The Straits Times reported the “Bumiputera-first policy debate” has taken on a “heady mix of health, education and politics.” When a UiTM professor suggested opening Bumiputera-only programmes to other races to address specialist shortages, the backlash was immediate and the idea was shut down.

item.title: [BM] Pembantu PM Sendiri Shamsul Iskandar Didakwa Rasuah — Perang Antirasuah Makan Diri Sendiri
item.description:
Said by: Reuters / Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-04

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 4 Disember 2025, setiausaha politik kanan Anwar Ibrahim, Shamsul Iskandar Mohd Akin, didakwa menerima rasuah berjumlah RM176,829 daripada seorang ahli perniagaan tempatan. Pertuduhan mendakwa Shamsul menggunakan kedudukannya yang istimewa di pejabat Perdana Menteri untuk membantu ahli perniagaan tersebut mendapatkan lesen perlombongan mineral di Sabah, antara lain. Shamsul meletak jawatan beberapa hari sebelum didakwa, mengaku tidak bersalah, dan diberikan jaminan. Beliau menyifatkan pertuduhan itu sebagai “serangan” terhadapnya. Reuters melaporkan pertuduhan itu “meningkatkan penelitian terhadap ikrar perdana menteri untuk membanteras rasuah dengan ketara.” CNA melaporkan Anwar kini menghadapi “krisis rasuah” di samping “perpecahan parti PKR” dan “kegelisahan gabungan PH.”

item.title: PM's Own Aide Shamsul Iskandar Charged with Bribery — Anti-Corruption Crusade Eats Itself
item.description:
Said by: Reuters / Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-04

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 4 December 2025, Anwar Ibrahim’s senior political secretary Shamsul Iskandar Mohd Akin was charged with receiving bribes totalling RM176,829 from a local businessman. The charges allege Shamsul used his privileged position in the Prime Minister’s office to assist the businessman in obtaining mineral mining licences in Sabah, among other favours. Shamsul resigned just days before being charged, pleaded not guilty, and was granted bail. He called the charges an “attack” against him. Reuters reported the charges “significantly increased scrutiny on the premier’s pledge to crack down on corruption.” CNA reported Anwar now faces a “graft crisis” alongside “PKR party fractures” and “PH coalition jitters.”

item.title: [BM] Anwar Bela Surat Sokongan Di Parlimen — Kemudian Serang Pembangkang Kerana Buat PERKARA SAMA
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim in Parliament / The Star

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-02

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Apabila dihadapkan di parlimen mengenai pembelaannya terhadap ‘surat sokongan’ (surat cadangan) untuk tender kerajaan, Anwar berpusing menyerang pembangkang dengan mendedahkan bahawa pegawai negeri Kelantan dan Terengganu juga mengeluarkan surat serupa. Beliau berkata: ‘Saya mesti menyeru kemunafikan — tiada satu perkataan pun mengenai surat oleh exco Kelantan dan Terengganu yang meminta kelulusan.’

🔥 Kenapa Ini Penting

Daripada menangani sama ada surat sokongan itu wajar (ia tidak — ia menjejaskan perolehan kompetitif), pembelaan Anwar ialah ‘pihak sana pun buat juga.’ Ini setaraf politik kanak-kanak yang ditangkap mencuri berkata ’tapi Johnny pun curi juga!’ Ia bukan pembelaan — ia pengakuan bahawa amalan itu sejagat dan tiada siapa, termasuk PH, berniat menghentikannya.

item.title: Anwar Defends Support Letters in Parliament — Then Attacks Opposition for Doing the EXACT Same Thing
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim in Parliament / The Star

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-02

📌 What Happened

When confronted in parliament about his defence of ‘recommendation letters’ (surat sokongan) for government tenders, Anwar pivoted to attacking the opposition by revealing that Kelantan and Terengganu state officials had also issued similar letters. He said: ‘I must call out the hypocrisy — there was not a single word on the letters by the Kelantan and Terengganu exco asking for approval.’

item.title: [BM] Kad Laporan Tiga Tahun Anwar: Ekonomi Stabil, Janji Dimungkiri, Kredibiliti Reformasi Runtuh
item.description:
Said by: Multiple analysts and media

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Ketika Anwar Ibrahim menandakan tiga tahun sebagai Perdana Menteri pada akhir 2025, pelbagai penganalisis dan media menyampaikan keputusan yang konsisten: ekonomi stabil, kredibiliti reformasi hancur. Pertumbuhan KDNK melebihi 5%, pelaburan asing mencecah rekod tertinggi, dan pengangguran mencapai paras terendah dalam satu dekad. Tetapi dalam reformasi — sebab sebenar PH dipilih — rekodnya amat mengecewakan: Akta Hasutan diperluaskan dengan 90 tangkapan, AUKU kekal utuh, ICCPR tidak diratifikasi, pemisahan PG-PP dihantar ke jawatankuasa selepas tiga tahun kelewatan, 47 pertuduhan rasuah Zahid digugurkan, SPRM diserang kerana politisasi, seorang wartawan ditangkap kerana bertanya soalan, dan Nurul Izzah dipasang sebagai No. 2 PKR.

item.title: [BM] Zafrul: Orang Yang Khidmat Setiap PM — Dari Menteri Kewangan Muhyiddin Ke Menteri Perdagangan Anwar Ke 'Penasihat Kanan'
item.description:
Said by: Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz telah mencapai apa yang tiada ahli politik Malaysia lain capai: berkhidmat dalam peranan menteri kanan di bawah tiga PM berturut-turut daripada tiga gabungan berbeza. Beliau adalah Menteri Kewangan di bawah Muhyiddin (PN) dan Ismail Sabri (BN-PN), kemudian beralih ke PKR dan menjadi Menteri MITI di bawah Anwar (PH). Selepas dirombak pada Disember 2025, beliau segera dilantik sebagai Penasihat Politik Kanan kepada PM dan Pengerusi MIDA. SCMP memprofilkannya sebagai ‘harta panas’ — orang yang setiap PM mahukan.

item.title: Anwar's Three-Year Report Card: Steady Economics, Broken Promises, Collapsing Reform Credibility
item.description:
Said by: Multiple analysts and media

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: As Anwar Ibrahim marked three years as Prime Minister in late 2025, multiple analysts and media outlets delivered a consistent verdict: steady economics, shattered reform credibility. GDP growth exceeded 5%, foreign investment hit record highs, and unemployment reached decade lows. But on reform — the actual reason PH was elected — the record is dismal: the Sedition Act was expanded with 90 arrests, UUCA remains intact, ICCPR is unratified, AG-PP separation was sent to committee after three years of delay, Zahid’s 47 corruption charges were dropped, MACC is under fire for politicisation, a journalist was arrested for asking a question, and Nurul Izzah was installed as PKR No. 2.

item.title: Zafrul: The Man Who Served Every PM — From Muhyiddin's Finance Minister to Anwar's Trade Minister to 'Senior Advisor'
item.description:
Said by: Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-12-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz has achieved what no other Malaysian politician has: serving in senior ministerial roles under three consecutive PMs from three different coalitions. He was Finance Minister under Muhyiddin (PN) and Ismail Sabri (BN-PN), then switched to PKR and became MITI Minister under Anwar (PH). After being reshuffled out in December 2025, he was immediately appointed Senior Political Advisor to the PM and MIDA Chairman. SCMP profiled him as ‘hot property’ — the man every PM wants.

item.title: [BM] PH Menang 1 Daripada 20 Kerusi Di Sabah — Anwar Kata Kekalahan Takkan Henti Penyampaian
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-11-30

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 30 November 2025, Pakatan Harapan dihancurkan dalam pilihan raya negeri Sabah. Gabungan itu memenangi hanya 1 daripada 20 kerusi yang dipertandingkan — turun daripada 7 sebelumnya. Itu kadar kekalahan 95%. Parti-parti berasaskan Sabah mendominasi, didorong sentimen anti-persekutuan dan tuntutan autonomi negeri yang lebih besar — terutama selepas keputusan Mahkamah Tinggi menyokong tuntutan Sabah terhadap 40% hasil persekutuan. Penganalisis politik Lee Kuok Tiung berkata terus terang: “Keputusan pilihan raya Sabah menunjukkan gabungan Anwar kalah teruk.” Jawapan Anwar: kekalahan itu “takkan menghalang penyampaian” janji kepada Sabah.

item.title: PH Wins 1 Out of 20 Seats in Sabah — Anwar Says Defeat Won't Stop Delivery
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-11-30

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 30 November 2025, Pakatan Harapan was demolished in the Sabah state election. The coalition won just 1 out of 20 seats it contested — down from 7 previously. That is a 95% loss rate. Sabah-based parties dominated, driven by anti-federal sentiment and demands for greater state autonomy — particularly after a High Court ruling supporting Sabah’s claim to 40% of federal revenue. Political analyst Lee Kuok Tiung said plainly: “The Sabah election outcome shows Anwar’s coalition lost badly.” Anwar’s response: the defeat “won’t stop delivery” of pledges to Sabah.

item.title: [BM] Setiausaha Politik PM Didapati Keluarkan Surat Sokongan Untuk Kontraktor Hospital — Anwar Kata Teguran Sudah Cukup
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-11-18

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada 18 November 2025, Anwar mengesahkan di Parlimen bahawa beliau telah menegur setiausaha politik kanan, Shamsul Iskandar Mohd Akin, mengenai surat sokongan yang menyenaraikan enam kontraktor untuk projek hospital di Johor. Anwar menggambarkan surat tersebut sebagai “kabur.” Pada 25 November, Shamsul meletak jawatan selepas tekanan media dan desakan Rafizi Ramli untuk siasatan SPRM. Seorang ahli perniagaan Sabah kemudian mendakwa memberikan RM152,000 kepada Shamsul — wang yang didakwa dibelanjakan untuk perabot rumah, cerut premium, dan sut bertempah. Pada 4 Disember 2025, SPRM mendakwa Shamsul dengan rasuah berjumlah RM176,829 berkaitan projek hospital itu.

item.title: PM's Political Secretary Caught Issuing Support Letters for Hospital Contractors — Anwar Says a Reprimand Is Enough
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-11-18

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 18 November 2025, Anwar confirmed in Parliament that he had reprimanded his senior political secretary, Shamsul Iskandar Mohd Akin, over support letters listing six contractors for a hospital project in Johor. Anwar described the letters as “vague.” On 25 November, Shamsul resigned after mounting media pressure and calls from Rafizi Ramli for a MACC investigation. A Sabah businessman then claimed he provided RM152,000 to Shamsul — money allegedly spent on home furniture, premium cigars, and tailored suits. On 4 December 2025, MACC charged Shamsul with corruption over RM176,829 in gratification related to the hospital project.

item.title: [BM] Pembantu MB Selangor Dituduh Kekayaan Tidak Dapat Dijelaskan — Banglo RM3J, Perjalanan Mewah, Dan Terlalu Banyak Jawatan GLC
item.description:
Said by: Amirudin Shari, Selangor Menteri Besar

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-11-15

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada November 2025, kumpulan WhatsApp baharu bernama ‘MB Selangor’ — terdiri daripada ahli DUN dan pemimpin negeri — mencetuskan kontroversi dengan menuduh seorang pemimpin PKR rapat dengan Menteri Besar Selangor Amirudin Shari mempunyai kekayaan tidak dapat dijelaskan. Pentadbir kumpulan mempersoalkan bagaimana pemimpin itu mampu memiliki banglo RM3 juta, perjalanan mewah ke luar negara, dan penginapan hotel mewah sambil memegang banyak jawatan dalam agensi berkaitan negeri. Kumpulan itu bertanya: ‘Mengapa seorang dilantik ke begitu banyak jawatan, seolah-olah tiada orang lain yang layak di Selangor?’

item.title: Selangor MB's Aide Accused of Unexplained Wealth — RM3M Bungalow, Luxury Trips, and Too Many GLC Posts
item.description:
Said by: Amirudin Shari, Selangor Menteri Besar

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-11-15

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In November 2025, a newly created WhatsApp group named ‘MB Selangor’ — comprising state assembly members and leaders — triggered controversy by accusing a PKR leader close to Selangor Menteri Besar Amirudin Shari of unexplained wealth. The administrator questioned how the leader could afford a RM3 million bungalow, luxury overseas trips, and high-end hotel stays while holding numerous positions in state-linked agencies. The group asked: ‘Why is one person appointed to so many positions, as if there are no other qualified people in Selangor?’

item.title: [BM] Parlimen Dijadikan Cap Getah — Cambuk PM Pastikan Rang Undang-Undang Lulus Tanpa Perbahasan Sebenar
item.description:
Said by: Opposition MPs / Parliamentary Reform Advocates

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-11-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Walaupun PH berjanji mengukuhkan demokrasi berparlimen, Dewan Rakyat terus berfungsi sebagai cap getah dan bukannya badan perundingan sebenar. Rang undang-undang kerajaan lulus dengan pindaan minimum, kerja jawatankuasa bersifat pro-forma, dan cambuk kerajaan memastikan AP gabungan mengundi secara blok. Rang undang-undang had tempoh PM — salah satu janji reformasi utama PH — gagal di Parlimen kerana PH tidak mampu mengumpulkan AP sendiri yang cukup untuk menyokongnya. Fahmi Fadzil menyalahkan “kekeliruan pembangkang” atas kegagalan itu, sedangkan 8 AP PH sendiri tidak hadir mengundi.

item.title: Parliament Reduced to Rubber Stamp — PM Whips Ensure Bills Pass Without Genuine Debate
item.description:
Said by: Opposition MPs / Parliamentary Reform Advocates

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-11-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Despite PH’s promise to strengthen parliamentary democracy, the Dewan Rakyat continues to function as a rubber stamp rather than a genuine deliberative body. Government bills pass with minimal amendment, committee work is perfunctory, and the government whip ensures coalition MPs vote in bloc. The PM term limit bill — one of PH’s signature reform promises — failed in Parliament because PH couldn’t even muster enough of its own MPs to support it. Fahmi Fadzil blamed “opposition confusion” for the failure, when 8 of PH’s own MPs didn’t show up to vote.

item.title: [BM] RTM Salah Kenal Pasti TIGA Pemimpin ASEAN Secara Langsung — Panggil PM Singapura 'Lee Hsien Loong' Di Sidang Kemuncak Yang Malaysia Anjurkan
item.description:
Said by: RTM / Communications Ministry under Fahmi Fadzil

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-10-26

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU

Pada 26 Oktober 2025, semasa siaran langsung majlis pembukaan Sidang Kemuncak ASEAN ke-47 — yang Malaysia sendiri menjadi tuan rumah — penyiar kebangsaan Radio Televisyen Malaysia (RTM) salah mengenal pasti tiga pemimpin Asia Tenggara:

  • PM Singapura Lawrence Wong dipanggil Lee Hsien Loong (pendahulunya)
  • PM Thailand Anutin Charnvirakul dipanggil Srettha Thavisin (pendahulunya)
  • Presiden Indonesia Prabowo Subianto dipanggil Jokowi (pendahulunya) RTM mengeluarkan dua kenyataan permohonan maaf berasingan. Jabatan penyiaran berkata ia “mengambil perkara ini dengan serius” dan “tindakan sewajarnya telah diambil.”

🔥 KENAPA IA PENTING

Ini adalah detik Malaysia di pentas dunia. Sidang Kemuncak ASEAN adalah acara diplomatik utama rantau ini, dan Malaysia menjadi tuan rumah. Seluruh rantau sedang menonton. Dan penyiar kebangsaan Malaysia tidak mampu menyebut nama tiga ketua negara jiran dengan betul.

item.title: RTM Misidentifies THREE ASEAN Leaders on Live TV — Calls Singapore's PM 'Lee Hsien Loong' at Summit Malaysia Hosted
item.description:
Said by: RTM / Communications Ministry under Fahmi Fadzil

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-10-26

📌 WHAT HAPPENED

On 26 October 2025, during the live broadcast of the opening ceremony of the 47th ASEAN Summit — which Malaysia was hosting — the national broadcaster Radio Televisyen Malaysia (RTM) misidentified three Southeast Asian leaders:

  • Singapore PM Lawrence Wong was called Lee Hsien Loong (his predecessor)
  • Thailand PM Anutin Charnvirakul was called Srettha Thavisin (his predecessor)
  • Indonesia President Prabowo Subianto was called Jokowi (his predecessor) RTM issued two separate apology statements. The broadcasting department said it “took the matter seriously” and that “appropriate action had been taken.”

🔥 WHY IT MATTERS

This was Malaysia’s moment on the world stage. The ASEAN Summit is the region’s premier diplomatic event, and Malaysia was the host. The entire region was watching. And Malaysia’s national broadcaster couldn’t get the names of three neighbouring heads of state right.

item.title: [BM] Dana SMUE RM200 Juta Didakwa Diseleweng — SPRM Siasat Skim Warga Emas Selangor
item.description:
Said by: Amirudin Shari / MACC

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-10-16

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Suruhanjaya Pencegahan Rasuah Malaysia melancarkan siasatan terhadap dakwaan penyelewengan RM200 juta daripada Skim Mesra Usia Emas (SMUE) Selangor — skim kebajikan warga emas negeri itu. Beberapa pegawai yang dikaitkan dengan skim itu disoal siasat. Dana SMUE direka untuk menyediakan bantuan kewangan kepada warga emas Selangor, menjadikan dakwaan penyelewengan itu amat keji — wang yang dimaksudkan untuk warga emas didakwa dialihkan ke tempat lain di bawah pemantauan PH.

item.title: [BM] Peguam Najib: Beliau Mungkin KEMBALI Ke Politik Jika Diampunkan
item.description:
Said by: Muhammad Shafee Abdullah, Najib’s Lawyer

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-10-16

Najib’s lawyer openly floated his client’s return to politics if pardoned. UMNO demanded his pardon at their assembly. Anwar is stuck between needing UMNO’s support and maintaining anti-graft credentials.

item.title: Najib's Lawyer: He May RETURN to Politics If Pardoned
item.description:
Said by: Muhammad Shafee Abdullah, Najib’s Lawyer

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-10-16

Najib’s lawyer openly floated his client’s return to politics if pardoned. UMNO demanded his pardon at their assembly. Anwar is stuck between needing UMNO’s support and maintaining anti-graft credentials.

item.title: RM200 Million SMUE Fund Allegedly Misappropriated — MACC Probes Selangor Senior Citizens' Scheme
item.description:
Said by: Amirudin Shari / MACC

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-10-16

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: The Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission launched an investigation into the alleged misappropriation of RM200 million from Selangor’s Skim Mesra Usia Emas (SMUE) — the state’s elderly welfare scheme. Multiple officials linked to the scheme were questioned. The SMUE fund was designed to provide financial assistance to Selangor’s senior citizens, making the alleged misappropriation particularly egregious — money meant for the elderly allegedly diverted elsewhere under PH’s watch.

item.title: [BM] Rafizi Amaran: Dakwaan Farhash Jejaskan Kelayakan Antirasuah PM
item.description:
Said by: Rafizi Ramli, Economy Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-10-15

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Rafizi secara terbuka menggesa Anwar untuk berhadapan dengan dakwaan terhadap Farhash Wafa, memberi amaran bahawa CPI Malaysia mendatar pada 50 mata — skor yang sama seperti 2015 semasa kemuncak skandal 1MDB. Kata ia ‘amat berbahaya jika pentadbiran dilihat tidak konsisten dalam memerangi rasuah.’

🔥 Kenapa Ia Penting

Apabila Menteri Ekonomi anda sendiri secara terbuka memberi amaran bahawa kelayakan antirasuah anda sedang runtuh, masalah itu tidak boleh dinafikan. Rafizi secara efektif memberitahu Anwar: keengganan anda bertindak terhadap Farhash secara terukur merosakkan skor rasuah negara. CPI 50 di bawah Anwar adalah sama seperti di bawah Najib semasa 1MDB — perbandingan itu sahaja sudah membinasakan.

item.title: Rafizi Warns: Farhash Allegations Undermine PM's Anti-Corruption Credentials
item.description:
Said by: Rafizi Ramli, Economy Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-10-15

📌 What Happened

Rafizi publicly urged Anwar to confront allegations against Farhash Wafa, warning that Malaysia’s CPI flatlined at 50 points — the same score as 2015 during the peak 1MDB scandal. Said it’s ’extremely dangerous if the administration is seen as inconsistent in combating corruption.'

🔥 Why It Matters

When your own Economy Minister publicly warns that your anti-corruption credentials are collapsing, the problem is undeniable. Rafizi effectively told Anwar: your refusal to act against Farhash is measurably damaging the country’s corruption score. A CPI of 50 under Anwar is the same as under Najib during 1MDB — that comparison alone is devastating.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Periksa Kerja Sendiri — PM Yang Juga Menteri Kewangan Bentangkan Bajet Dan Dakwa Ia Hebat
item.description:
Said by: Opposition / Budget Analysts

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-10-10

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Bajet 2026 dibentangkan oleh Anwar Ibrahim — sebagai Menteri Kewangan — kepada parlimen, di mana beliau duduk sebagai Perdana Menteri. Beliau kemudian mempertahankan bajetnya sendiri di parlimen, memuji pencapaiannya, dan menolak kritikan. Orang yang menulis peperiksaan juga orang yang memberikan markah.

🔥 Kenapa Ia Penting

Dalam mana-mana demokrasi yang berfungsi, fungsi kewangan mempunyai pengawasan bebas daripada kepimpinan politik. Apabila satu orang mengawal kedua-dua agenda politik dan dompet negara, tiada semakan bermakna terhadap keputusan fiskal. Peruntukan bajet menjadi alat politik tanpa penelitian bebas. Peranan Parlimen sebagai badan pengawasan bajet terjejas apabila PM/MK mengawal kedua-dua eksekutif dan agenda fiskal.

item.title: Anwar Marks His Own Homework — PM Who Is Also Finance Minister Presents Budget and Claims It's Great
item.description:
Said by: Opposition / Budget Analysts

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-10-10

📌 What Happened

Budget 2026 was presented by Anwar Ibrahim — as Finance Minister — to parliament, where he sits as Prime Minister. He then defended his own budget in parliament, praised its achievements, and dismissed criticism. The person who wrote the exam is also the person who grades it.

🔥 Why It Matters

In any functional democracy, the finance function has oversight independent from the political leadership. When one person controls both the political agenda and the national wallet, there is no meaningful check on fiscal decisions. Budget allocations become political tools without independent scrutiny. Parliament’s role as a budget oversight body is undermined when the PM/FM controls both the executive and the fiscal agenda.

item.title: [BM] Tiong King Sing Hidang Arak Di Majlis Makan Malam Rasmi Pelancongan, Kemudian Berbohong Tentang Siapa Penganjurnya
item.description:
Said by: Tiong King Sing, Tourism, Arts and Culture Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-10-05

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU

Menteri Pelancongan, Seni dan Budaya Tiong King Sing dikecam pada Oktober 2025 selepas minuman beralkohol dihidangkan di majlis makan malam gala semasa Global Travel Meet — acara yang dianjurkan di bawah bendera Tourism Malaysia. Klip video menunjukkan bir dan wain dihidangkan kepada tetamu Muslim, menyebabkan beberapa orang meninggalkan lebih awal.

Tiong pada mulanya menafikan tanggungjawab, mendakwa sektor swasta menganjurkan jamuan dan ia “bukan sebahagian daripada program rasmi Tourism Malaysia.” Tetapi bekas Menteri Kesihatan Khairy Jamaluddin menyiarkan tangkapan skrin di Instagram menunjukkan Tourism Malaysia disenaraikan sebagai penganjur majlis makan malam gala, mengejek Tiong dengan “Liar, liar pants on fire.”

item.title: [BM] Farhash Wafa Dibebaskan SPRM Atas Perlombongan Sabah — Muda Kecam 'Cuba Gembirakan PM'

Category: Politics

SPRM membebaskan bekas pembantu Anwar, Farhash Wafa, atas skandal perlombongan Sabah, walaupun Bloomberg mendakwa Anwar mengarahkan SPRM supaya tidak menyiasat. Muda menuduh ketua SPRM Azam Baki ‘cuba bertahan dengan menggembirakan PM.’

🔥 Mengapa Ia Penting

Apabila pembantu politik PM sendiri dituduh rasuah dalam urus niaga perlombongan dan agensi antirasuah membebaskan mereka tanpa penjelasan awam yang boleh dipercayai, kebebasan agensi tersebut dipersoalkan. Dakwaan Bloomberg — bahawa Anwar campur tangan secara langsung untuk menghentikan siasatan — adalah letupan besar. Jika benar, ia bermakna pejuang antirasuah menghalang siasatan antirasuah. Jika palsu, kerajaan tidak memberikan bukti untuk menyangkalnya.

item.title: Farhash Wafa Cleared by MACC Over Sabah Mining — Muda Slams 'Pleasing the PM'
item.description:
Said by: Azam Baki, MACC Chief Commissioner

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-09-09

📌 What Happened

MACC cleared Anwar’s former aide Farhash Wafa over the Sabah mining scandal, despite Bloomberg alleging Anwar ordered MACC not to investigate. Muda accused MACC chief Azam Baki of ’trying to survive by pleasing the PM.'

🔥 Why It Matters

When a PM’s own political aide is accused of corruption in a mining deal and the anti-corruption agency clears them without a credible public explanation, the agency’s independence is in question. Bloomberg’s allegation — that Anwar directly intervened to stop the investigation — is explosive. If true, it means the anti-corruption crusader is obstructing anti-corruption investigations. If false, the government has not provided evidence to refute it.

item.description:
Said by: Multiple analysts and commentators

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-09-01

Gabungan Yang Mustahil

Anwar Ibrahim mentadbir Malaysia melalui gabungan yang menjadikan reformasi mustahil secara struktur. Lelaki yang berkempen selama berdekad menentang rasuah kini bergantung kepada parti yang membolehkan kleptokrasi terbesar dunia.

Watak-Watak Utama

  • Anwar Ibrahim (PKR): Membina kerjayanya atas reformasi, antirasuah, dan tadbir urus bersih.
  • Ahmad Zahid Hamidi (UMNO): Timbalan PM. Menghadapi 47 pertuduhan rasuah. Semuanya digugurkan.
  • DAP: Suara reformasi paling konsisten dalam gabungan. Dipinggirkan secara sistematik dalam rombakan Disember 2025.
  • UMNO: Parti Najib. Mengancam untuk menyemak semula hubungan gabungan apabila AP DAP meraikan kekalahan mahkamah Najib.

Masalah Struktur

Seperti yang dinyatakan Fair Observer, gabungan Anwar pada asasnya tidak stabil kerana ahli-ahlinya mempunyai kepentingan yang bertentangan:

item.title: Anwar's Coalition Contradictions: Reformist PM, Corrupt DPM, and a Party That Enabled 1MDB
item.description:
Said by: Multiple analysts and commentators

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-09-01

The Impossible Coalition

Anwar Ibrahim governs Malaysia through a coalition that makes reform structurally impossible. The man who campaigned for decades against corruption now depends on the party that enabled the world’s largest kleptocracy.

The Cast of Characters

  • Anwar Ibrahim (PKR): Built his career on reformasi, anti-corruption, and clean governance.
  • Ahmad Zahid Hamidi (UMNO): Deputy PM. Faced 47 corruption charges. All dropped.
  • DAP: The coalition’s most consistent reform voice. Systematically sidelined in the December 2025 reshuffle.
  • UMNO: Najib’s party. Threatened to review coalition ties when a DAP MP celebrated Najib’s court loss.

The Structural Problem

As Fair Observer noted, Anwar’s coalition is fundamentally unstable because its members have opposing interests:

Reuters melaporkan: “Ribuan orang berhimpun di ibu negara Malaysia menuntut peletakan jawatan Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim, ketika rasa tidak puas hati orang ramai meningkat terhadap kos sara hidup yang melonjak dan dakwaan gagal menunaikan janji reformasi.”

Said by: Malaysian Public / Opposition Coalition

Date: 2025-07-26

📌 WHAT HAPPENED

On 26 July 2025, an estimated 18,000 people filled Dataran Merdeka (Independence Square) in Kuala Lumpur, wearing black t-shirts and bandannas with the slogan “Turun Anwar” (Step Down Anwar). It was the first major anti-government protest since Anwar came to power in 2022.

Reuters reported: “Thousands of people rallied in the Malaysian capital to demand the resignation of Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim, as public discontent grows over rising living costs and allegations of failing to deliver promised reforms.”

Merampas RM3 Bilion Daripada Keluarga Si Mati

The Facts

Fact: Daim served twice as Finance Minister and was credited with helping Malaysia recover from the 1997 Asian Financial Crisis.

item.title: [BM] Perbicaraan Rasuah Lim Guan Eng — Pegawai SPRM Beri Keterangan Mengenai Wang Diberi Kepada Bekas KM Pulau Pinang

Gnanaraja dan Lim Guan Eng berkaitan projek terowong dasar laut Pulau Pinang. Penguasa Kanan SPRM Ng Heng Jun mengesahkan beliau telah memaklumkan pegawai atasan mengenai kenyataan Zarul. Projek terowong itu, bernilai RM6.3 bilion, telah digambarkan oleh saksi SPRM sebagai ‘serupa penipuan tanah.’

item.description:
Said by: Lim Guan Eng, former Penang CM / MACC

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-07-10

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: On 10 July 2025, a MACC investigating officer told the Sessions Court that during a fraud investigation in December 2019, Datuk Zarul Ahmad Mohd Zulkifli — then director of Consortium Zenith Construction (CZCSB) — revealed he had given money to both G. Gnanaraja and Lim Guan Eng in connection with the Penang undersea tunnel project. MACC Senior Superintendent Ng Heng Jun confirmed he had informed his superiors about Zarul’s statement. The tunnel project, worth RM6.3 billion, has been described by MACC witnesses as ‘akin to a land scam.’

item.title: [BM] GLC Sebagai Tempat Buang Politik — 47.5 Lantikan Setahun, Lebih Banyak Daripada Mahathir 2.0
item.description:
Said by: IDEAS Think Tank Research

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-07-04

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Penyelidikan badan pemikir IDEAS mendapati kerajaan Anwar melantik purata 47.5 lantikan politik setahun ke Syarikat Berkaitan Kerajaan (GLC) dan badan berkanun — melebihi kadar Mahathir 2.0 sebanyak 43 setahun dan jauh melebihi matlamat lantikan berasaskan merit. Sebanyak 238 lantikan politik didokumenkan sepanjang tahun-tahun pertama Anwar.

🔥 Mengapa Ia Penting

GLC mengawal bahagian besar ekonomi Malaysia — Petronas, Khazanah, TNB, Telekom, MAHB, dan berpuluh-puluh lagi. Apabila jawatan lembaga pengarah diisi berdasarkan kesetiaan politik dan bukannya kecekapan, akibatnya besar: keputusan strategik yang lemah, rasuah, dan salah urus. Setiap lantikan politik yang kurang kemahiran untuk peranan mereka merugikan ekonomi dari segi kecekapan, inovasi, dan nilai pemegang saham.

item.title: [BM] Reformasi Perkhidmatan Awam: Tiga Tahun Bercakap, Sifar Perubahan Struktur — 1.6 Juta Birokrat Tidak Disentuh
item.description:
Said by: IDEAS / Public Policy Analysts

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-07-04

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Anwar Ibrahim memasuki pejabat menjanjikan reformasi perkhidmatan awam menyeluruh — pemodenan, meritokrasi, mengecilkan birokrasi yang gemuk yang memakan bahagian besar belanjawan negara. Tiga tahun kemudian, perkhidmatan awam kekal pada dasarnya tidak berubah: 1.3-1.6 juta pekerja (tidak termasuk polis dan tentera), 90% Bumiputera, memakan kira-kira 40% daripada jumlah perbelanjaan mengurus kerajaan dalam gaji dan pencen.

🔥 Mengapa Ia Penting

Badan pemikir IDEAS mendapati kerajaan Anwar sebenarnya meningkatkan lantikan politik ke GLC dan badan berkanun, purata 47.5 setahun — melebihi kadar Mahathir 2.0 sebanyak 43 setahun. Birokrasi yang gemuk bermakna Malaysia membelanjakan lebih banyak untuk gaji penjawat awam berbanding perbelanjaan pembangunan. Kewajipan pencen terus membengkak tanpa reformasi struktur.

item.title: Civil Service Reform: Three Years of Talk, Zero Structural Change — 1.6 Million Bureaucrats Untouched
item.description:
Said by: IDEAS / Public Policy Analysts

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-07-04

📌 What Happened

Anwar Ibrahim entered office promising sweeping civil service reform — modernisation, meritocracy, right-sizing a bloated bureaucracy that consumes a massive share of the national budget. Three years later, the civil service remains essentially unchanged: 1.3-1.6 million employees (excluding police and military), 90% Bumiputera, consuming approximately 40% of total government operating expenditure in salaries and pensions.

🔥 Why It Matters

IDEAS think tank found that the Anwar government actually increased political appointments to GLCs and statutory bodies, averaging 47.5 per year — exceeding even Mahathir 2.0’s rate of 43 per year. The bloated bureaucracy means Malaysia spends more on civil servant wages than on development spending. Pension obligations continue to balloon with no structural reform.

item.title: GLCs as Political Dumping Ground — 47.5 Appointees Per Year, Even MORE Than Mahathir 2.0
item.description:
Said by: IDEAS Think Tank Research

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-07-04

📌 What Happened

Research by IDEAS think tank found that the Anwar government appointed an average of 47.5 political appointees per year to Government-Linked Companies (GLCs) and statutory bodies — exceeding even Mahathir 2.0’s rate of 43 per year and far surpassing the stated goal of merit-based appointments. A total of 238 political appointments were documented across Anwar’s first years.

item.title: [BM] Syed Saddiq Dibebaskan Selepas '5 Tahun Azab' — Adakah Ia Pendakwaan Politik?
item.description:
Said by: Court of Appeal / Prosecution

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-06-25

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Mahkamah Rayuan sebulat suara membebaskan Syed Saddiq daripada kesemua 4 pertuduhan, menegur Mahkamah Tinggi kerana tidak menolak kes itu lebih awal. Beliau telah dijatuhkan hukuman 7 tahun penjara dan sebatan oleh mahkamah bawahan. Pendakwaan kemudian merayu ke Mahkamah Persekutuan, yang memberikan ’tempoh bertenang’ yang jarang berlaku. SCMP memanggilnya ‘5 tahun azab.’

🔥 Mengapa Ia Penting

Seorang ahli politik pembangkang muda telah melalui setengah dekad prosiding undang-undang yang Mahkamah Rayuan kata sepatutnya ditolak jauh lebih awal. Sama ada bermotif politik atau tidak, sistem telah mengecewakan beliau. Sabitan asal begitu lemah sehinggakan mahkamah rayuan jelas kecewa.

item.title: Syed Saddiq Acquitted After '5 Years of Hell' — Was It Political Prosecution?
item.description:
Said by: Court of Appeal / Prosecution

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-06-25

📌 What Happened

Court of Appeal unanimously acquitted Syed Saddiq of all 4 charges, admonishing the High Court for not throwing out the case earlier. He had been sentenced to 7 years jail and caning by the lower court. The prosecution then appealed to the Federal Court, which gave a rare ‘cooling-off period.’ SCMP called it ‘5 years of hell.’

item.title: [BM] CSIS Isytihar 'Kematian Reformasi' — Gerakan Anwar Sendiri Diisytihar Mati Oleh Badan Pemikir Washington
item.description:
Said by: Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS)

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-06-01

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS), salah satu badan pemikir dasar paling berpengaruh di Washington, menerbitkan analisis yang memusnahkan bertajuk ‘Kematian Reformasi: Anwar Ibrahim, UMNO, dan Pengkhianatan Sebuah Gerakan.’ Artikel itu berhujah bahawa identiti politik Anwar telah ‘semakin ditakrifkan oleh kompromi yang beliau buat untuk memastikan kedudukannya dalam kerajaan.’

🔥 Mengapa Ia Penting

Reformasi bukan sekadar gerakan politik — ia adalah janji generasi. Berjuta-juta rakyat Malaysia, daripada pelajar universiti hingga keluarga kelas pekerja, melaburkan berdekad harapan, bantahan, dan pengorbanan dalam kepercayaan bahawa Anwar Ibrahim mewakili politik yang berbeza secara asasi. CSIS mengisytiharkannya mati bukan retorik pembangkang — ia adalah keputusan pertubuhan dasar antarabangsa.

item.title: CSIS Declares 'The Death of Reformasi' — Anwar's Own Movement Pronounced Dead by Washington Think Tank
item.description:
Said by: Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS)

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-06-01

📌 What Happened

The Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS), one of Washington’s most influential policy think tanks, published a devastating analysis titled ‘The Death of Reformasi: Anwar Ibrahim, UMNO, and the Betrayal of a Movement.’ The piece argues that Anwar’s political identity has been ‘increasingly defined by the compromises he has made to secure his position within the government.’

item.title: [BM] Nik Nazmi Letak Jawatan Menteri Alam Sekitar Selepas Kalah Pilihan Raya Parti PKR — Dedahkan Politik Feudal PH
item.description:

Perletakan jawatannya datang beberapa jam selepas Menteri Ekonomi Rafizi Ramli juga meletak jawatan — kedua-duanya berikutan kekalahan mereka dalam pilihan raya dalaman PKR lima hari sebelumnya.

item.title: [BM] Rafizi Ramli Letak Jawatan Menteri Ekonomi Selepas Dimalukan PKR — Reformis Yang Disingkirkan
item.description:
Said by: Rafizi Ramli, former Economy Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-05-28

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU

Pada 28 Mei 2025, Menteri Ekonomi Rafizi Ramli menyerahkan perletakan jawatannya daripada Kabinet, berkuat kuasa 17 Jun. Sekutunya, Menteri Sumber Asli Nik Nazmi Nik Ahmad, turut mengumumkan pemergiannya, berkuat kuasa 4 Julai.

Rafizi berkata: “Saya memasuki politik untuk memupuk budaya politik baru yang berasaskan akauntabiliti dan mandat rakyat. Kekalahan saya baru-baru ini dalam pilihan raya PKR menandakan saya tidak lagi memiliki mandat parti.”

item.title: Nik Nazmi Resigns as Environment Minister After Losing PKR Party Election — Exposes PH's Feudal Politics
item.description:
Said by: Nik Nazmi Nik Ahmad, Former Natural Resources and Environmental Sustainability Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-05-28

📌 WHAT HAPPENED

On May 28, 2025, Natural Resources and Environmental Sustainability Minister Nik Nazmi Nik Ahmad tendered his resignation from Cabinet, effective July 4. His resignation came hours after Economy Minister Rafizi Ramli also resigned — both following their defeats in PKR’s internal party elections five days earlier.

Nik Nazmi lost his PKR vice-president position and said he could no longer serve as minister without a full party mandate. “Being a minister can trap you in a ‘bubble’ — with privileges, security escorts, and protocols at every event,” he said. “I believe that becoming too attached to such a lifestyle can be dangerous.”

item.title: Rafizi Ramli Resigns as Economy Minister After PKR Humiliation — The Reformist Who Got Purged
item.description:
Said by: Rafizi Ramli, former Economy Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-05-28

📌 WHAT HAPPENED

On 28 May 2025, Economy Minister Rafizi Ramli submitted his resignation from Cabinet, effective 17 June. His ally, Natural Resources Minister Nik Nazmi Nik Ahmad, also announced his exit, effective 4 July.

Rafizi said: “I entered politics to cultivate a new political culture grounded in accountability and the people’s mandate. My recent defeat in the PKR elections signifies that I no longer possess the party’s mandate.”

item.title: [BM] Nurul Izzah Menang Timbalan Presiden PKR — Anwar Kata Demokrasi, Bukan Nepotisme
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister & PKR President

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-05-24

Daripada Penasihat Kepada Timbalan Presiden: Dinasti Anwar Terbentuk

Pada Mei 2025, Nurul Izzah Anwar dipilih sebagai Timbalan Presiden PKR — jawatan nombor dua dalam parti yang diketuai bapanya, Perdana Menteri yang sedang berkhidmat. Anwar Ibrahim menolak semua kritikan dengan lambaian tangan: dia dipilih oleh ahli. Kes ditutup. Kecuali ia tidak.

Apa Yang Berlaku

Di Kongres Nasional PKR di Johor Bahru pada 24 Mei 2025, Nurul Izzah memenangi pertandingan Timbalan Presiden. Jawatan presiden — yang dipegang Anwar — tidak dipertandingkan. Ini bermakna dua jawatan teratas PKR kini dipegang oleh ayah dan anak perempuan.

item.title: Nurul Izzah Wins PKR Deputy President — Anwar Says It's Democracy, Not Nepotism
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister & PKR President

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-05-24

From Adviser to Deputy President: The Anwar Dynasty Takes Shape

In May 2025, Nurul Izzah Anwar was elected PKR Deputy President — the number two position in the party led by her father, the sitting Prime Minister. Anwar Ibrahim dismissed all criticism with a wave of the hand: she was chosen by members. Case closed. Except it isn’t.

item.title: [BM] Nurul Izzah Tewaskan Rafizi Dengan 6,000 Undi Untuk Timbalan Presiden PKR — Parti Ayah, Peraturan Ayah
item.description:
Said by: PKR Party Elections / Nurul Izzah Anwar

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-05-23

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU

Pada 23 Mei 2025, Nurul Izzah Anwar — anak sulung Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim — menewaskan timbalan presiden penyandang Rafizi Ramli dalam pilihan raya dalaman PKR dengan margin yang meyakinkan: 9,803 undi berbanding 3,866.

Keputusannya tidak pernah diragui. Lebih 200 daripada 222 bahagian PKR telah mengisytiharkan sokongan untuk Nurul Izzah sebelum undian dijalankan. Pilihan raya diadakan di Johor Bahru, dengan presiden parti Anwar Ibrahim mengekalkan jawatan teratas tanpa dicabar.

item.title: Nurul Izzah Defeats Rafizi by 6,000 Votes for PKR Deputy President — Daddy's Party, Daddy's Rules
item.description:
Said by: PKR Party Elections / Nurul Izzah Anwar

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-05-23

📌 WHAT HAPPENED

On 23 May 2025, Nurul Izzah Anwar — the eldest daughter of Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim — defeated incumbent deputy president Rafizi Ramli in PKR’s internal elections by a commanding margin: 9,803 votes to 3,866.

The result was never in doubt. Over 200 of PKR’s 222 divisions had declared support for Nurul Izzah before the vote even took place. The election was held in Johor Bahru, with party president Anwar Ibrahim retaining the top post unchallenged.

item.title: [BM] 'Penasihat' Steven Sim Rupanya Suspek Penipuan RM10 Juta — Menteri Dakwa Tak Pernah Lantik Sesiapa
item.description:
Said by: Steven Sim, Human Resources Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-03-31

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU

Pada Mac 2025, seorang ahli perniagaan bergelar “Tan Sri” ditahan oleh pasukan pencegahan pengubahan wang haram Bukit Aman kerana didakwa menipu orang ramai sebanyak RM10 juta. Lelaki berusia 59 tahun itu, yang mempunyai 30 tahun pengalaman dalam industri minyak dan gas, ditahan sebaik pulang ke rumahnya di Jalan U Thant, KL, selepas perjalanan dari Osaka, Jepun.

item.title: Steven Sim's 'Adviser' Turns Out to Be Alleged RM10 Million Fraudster — Minister Claims He Never Appointed Anyone
item.description:
Said by: Steven Sim, Human Resources Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-03-31

📌 WHAT HAPPENED

In March 2025, a businessman with the title “Tan Sri” was arrested by Bukit Aman’s anti-money laundering team for allegedly defrauding the public of RM10 million. The 59-year-old, who had 30 years of experience in the oil and gas industry, was apprehended upon returning to his home at Jalan U Thant, KL, after a trip to Osaka, Japan.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Serang Balik Pengkritik Yang Kata Dia Terlalu Banyak Melancong — 'Mereka Tak Faham Kerja Keras'
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-02-27

PM Terbang Yang Tak Boleh Terima Kritikan

Apabila rakyat Malaysia mempersoalkan mengapa PM mereka sentiasa di luar negara sementara krisis domestik meningkat, respons Anwar bukan empati — ia kemarahan. Beliau menyerang pengkritik, berkata mereka “jelas tidak menyedari kerja keras” yang terlibat dalam perjalanan luar negara.

Fakta

Fakta: Anwar mempertahankan jadual perjalanan luar negaranya yang meluas, menolak pengkritik sebagai tidak berpengetahuan.

item.title: [BM] East Asia Forum: 'Aspirasi Reformasi Bertembung Dengan Realiti Politik Pada 2024'
item.description:
Said by: Kai Ostwald, University of British Columbia

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-02-27

Academic analysis: ‘Anwar pivoted from political survival in 2023 to pursuing an ambitious reform agenda in 2024, with notable gains in economic growth. Yet political turbulence — driven by identity-based populism and an unwieldy coalition — continued to constrain domestic reforms.’ Sources: https://eastasiaforum.org/2025/02/27/malaysias-reform-aspirations-clashed-with-political-realities-in-2024/

item.title: Anwar Hits Back at Critics Who Say He Travels Too Much — 'They Don't Understand Hard Work'
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2025-02-27

The Jet-Setting PM Who Can’t Take Criticism

When Malaysians questioned why their PM was constantly abroad while domestic crises mounted, Anwar’s response was not empathy — it was indignation. He hit out at critics, saying they were “clearly unaware of the hard work” that goes into overseas trips.

The Facts

Fact: Anwar defended his extensive overseas travel schedule, dismissing critics as uninformed.

item.title: [BM] Unit Propaganda J-Kom Terus Hidup — PH Kekalkan Jentera Yang Pernah Dikutuknya
item.description:
